title: Airbnb Guest Communications Specialist – Overnight (High Ownership)
description:
THIS IS NOT A SCRIPTED SUPPORT JOB.

RivetStays runs short-term rental homes for guests across North America (Airbnb, 
, VRBO, Expedia). Overnight in the Philippines, you're the person in charge. You'll handle guests, cleaners and maintenance in real time, with imperfect information and real consequences. We're hiring people who own the outcome, not people who read scripts and escalate.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

• Guest messages and calls, start to finish: check-in problems, complaints, requests, reviews

• Cleaners, maintenance and vendors when something breaks, in real time

• Refunds, credits and compensation decisions. You don't need permission for every dollar. Make the right call for the guest and the business, and own the result, good or bad. Your authority grows as your judgment proves itself.

• Keeping reservations, listings and our systems accurate (Beds24, Breezeway, PriceLabs, ClickUp, Missive, RingCentral)

• Back-office operations: expense and invoice tracking, discrepancy reporting, and bigger projects as you earn them

• Root causes: when something breaks twice, you fix the process, not just the ticket



HOW WE WORK

We use AI everywhere. You should already use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar every day (drafting replies, summarizing long threads, checking your work, automating repetitive tasks) and know when not to trust it.



YOU'RE A FIT IF

• You take in messy, complicated information and make a sound call fast, without freezing

• When something goes wrong on your watch, you fix it first and explain after. No excuses, no finger-pointing.

• You catch the detail everyone else missed

• You don't clock out on a broken situation. You finish it or hand it off clean.

• You care whether the guest actually had a great stay, not whether the ticket got closed



DON'T APPLY IF

• You need a script for everything

• You escalate every decision to a supervisor

• You want to clock in, answer messages and clock out



REQUIREMENTS

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Available for overnight shifts (PH time), including weekends and holidays

• Quiet workspace, 50 Mbps+ internet, your own reliable computer with a webcam

• Short-term rental or hospitality experience is a plus, not a requirement. Judgment and ownership matter more.



WHAT YOU GET

• Competitive hourly pay in USD, with raises for top performers

• Full-time hours, with extra paid hours whenever guests need them

• Real authority and a long-term role on a team that uses modern tools



HIRING PROCESS

Our process is harder than a typical support job, on purpose.

1. Online application and assessment (~70 min): your resume, a realistic shift simulation (AI tools allowed), an AI video interview, and two short tests

2. Interview with HR

3. Final interview

4. Two-week paid training



HOW TO APPLY

Apply here: 

We only review applications submitted through the link.

title: Part-Time B2B SDR | Paid Training | $480/Month Base + Commissions | Leads, CRM & Dialer Provided
description:
Build a real path into B2B sales—with qualified leads, a CRM, proven scripts, structured training, call coaching, and a professional U.S. dialer already provided.



EditValue provides premium wedding-video post-production for wedding photographers and studios. We are hiring a confident English-speaking SDR to introduce our service to U.S. wedding businesses and help them try a complimentary wedding reel.



Why this role is worth your time:

• You do not need to find your own leads

• We provide the CRM, dialer, sales playbook, scripts, training materials, and coaching

• Every call is recorded so you can receive specific feedback and improve

• Our Local Presence system displays a clean local U.S. caller ID matching the prospect’s area code, which can improve answer rates

• There is a clear paid path from training to live calls and long-term work

• Base pay plus uncapped commissions rewards both consistency and results



Schedule:

• Monday–Friday only; no weekend calling

• 9:00 AM–1:00 PM in the local U.S. time zone assigned to your leads

• Four consecutive hours per day

• This normally means evening or overnight hours in the Philippines, depending on the assigned U.S. territory



Your responsibilities:

• Make 200 calls per day during your four-hour calling shift (50 calls per hour), both during the live trial and regular work

• Speak naturally and confidently with wedding photographers and studio owners

• Explain EditValue clearly and offer one complimentary wedding reel

• Ask useful questions, identify decision-makers, and follow up with interested studios

• Accurately record dispositions and notes in the CRM

• The key outcome is getting an interested wedding studio to send footage for its complimentary reel



Compensation after successfully completing the live trial:

• $480/month guaranteed base

• $20 for every qualified wedding studio that submits wedding footage

• $70 for every new paying client

• Unlimited commissions



Your clear path into the role:

1. Application review — Send a 30–60 second audio or video recording explaining why you would be strong at cold calling.

2. SDR scenario test — A short, unpaid online assessment showing how you would handle one realistic cold-call scenario.

3. Paid SDR101 preparation — Guided learning and practice so you understand EditValue, the offer, and how to approach prospects.

4. Paid simulated-call training — Complete 25 coached calls across five levels. The session takes two hours or more. We pay $10 through PayPal after full completion.

5. Paid three-day live trial — Four consecutive hours per day, 200 calls per day, paid at $20 per completed day. You will receive the dialer, CRM access, leads, instructions, and feedback.

6. Longer-term opportunity — Strong performers may advance to a paid two-week evaluation, then a full month and ongoing employment. Our goal is a reliable long-term SDR relationship.



Payments during the assessment process are made through PayPal, so you must be able to receive PayPal payments.



Who will do well:

• Excellent spoken English and clear pronunciation

• Confidence speaking with U.S. business owners

• Previous B2B, SDR, appointment-setting, or cold-calling experience is preferred

• Coachable, reliable, and willing to apply feedback quickly

• Comfortable working the stated U.S. hours

• Reliable computer, internet connection, and microphone

• Consistent, accurate CRM use



Learn about the service before applying: 



How to apply:

Please include a 30–60 second audio or video recording and explain why you would be great at cold calling.



Applications without a recording will not be considered.

title: CLIENT RELATIONSHIP MANAGER - $1,500–$2,000 BASE + BONUSES
description:
Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Get certified in 30–60 days through consistent quality work and leadership approval.



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- You may split your shift

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Attend team/training meetings around 9 PM – 11 PM PH time (when scheduled)

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- We'll agree on your final schedule during the hiring process - it must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize their brand online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Fluent, professional English

- Clear spoken communication

- Emotional intelligence

- Be calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



You’ll THRIVE here if you:



- Enjoy speaking on camera with clients

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without being micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients

title: Full-Time AI Creative Strategist & Video Editor
description:
Full-Time AI Creative Strategist & Video Editor



Background



We’re a fast-growing social media agency producing high-performing short-form content across Instagram,
, YouTube, and more. WE’RE SCALING FAST!!



This isn't just a job. As the agency grows, the team grows with it. More clients means more volume, higher bonuses, and bigger opportunities for the people who helped build it. We believe in rewarding the people who show up, execute well, and grow with us and we're looking for someone who wants to be part of that from the ground floor.



We’re hiring a full-time AI Creative Strategist to analyze social media data from posted videos, understand content and marketing on a fundamental level, create raw AI clips, and assemble them into polished short-form videos using our internal workflows.



This is a strategy AND execution role. You’ll be taught from the ground up how to actually think like a creator - not just how to follow instructions.



If you haven't used every tool on our stack yet, that's okay. We care much more about having a hunger to learn, strong English, and your ability to improve independently. We'll give you the resources - what you do with them is up to you.



What You'll Do



Creative Strategy & Data

- Analyze the performance of posted videos and understand WHY certain content wins or loses

- Use data to create a feedback loop and continuously improve future videos

- Identify winning hooks, formats, angles, pacing, and creative patterns

- Research competitors, audiences, trends, and high-performing content

- Come to us with what you've learned, what you've changed, and where you need advice - not wait for us to tell you what to do 



Copywriting & Content

- Understand the fundamentals of hooks, storytelling, retention, persuasion, and customer psychology

- Write and improve short-form scripts based on research and performance data

- Identify weaknesses in scripts and creatives before production

- Develop new ideas and angles instead of simply recreating existing content

- Adapt content to different brands, audiences, and niches 



Video Editing

- Turn raw footage and AI-generated assets into high-retention short-form content

- Edit in CapCut with strong pacing, captions, B-roll, overlays, sound design, and visual storytelling

- Develop a strong creative eye and independently identify what needs improvement

- Maintain quality and consistency across multiple client accounts

- Apply feedback quickly and make sure the same mistakes don't keep happening 



AI Content Creation

- Generate AI images, videos, avatars, voices, and other creative assets using our tools

- Use tools such as ChatGPT, Grok, Veo3, and others as part of the creative process

- Experiment with new tools and workflows as AI technology evolves

- Quality check all AI outputs before using them in content

- Learn how to get better outputs instead of relying on us to provide every prompt or solution 



General

- Manage multiple projects without missing deadlines

- Communicate proactively about progress, ideas, problems, and results

- Take ownership of your work from research to final output

- Constantly look for ways to improve your own skills and the team's content

- Solve problems independently before immediately asking for help 



Requirements



Must-Haves

- EXTREMELY STRONG ENGLISH - WRITTEN, SPOKEN, AND COMPREHENSION

- GROWTH MINDSET AND GENUINE HUNGER TO LEARN!!!! 

- Experience editing short-form content - PORTFOLIO REQUIRED

- Strong WiFi connection with rare occurrences of outages

- Strong proficiency in CapCut

- Strong attention to detail and creative quality

- Able to think critically and understand WHY content performs

- Comfortable working with data and using it to improve creative decisions

- Willing to learn copywriting, marketing, AI, editing, and content strategy

- Extremely proactive - you should be coming to us with improvements, not waiting for us to find your mistakes

- Able to research and teach yourself when you don't know something

- Able to take feedback without ego and immediately apply it

- Willing to go above and beyond what is directly assigned

- Able to manage multiple projects without missing deadlines

- Reliable internet and dedicated workspace

- Currently working with NO OTHER CLIENTS. All work commitment should be on this role.



Nice-to-Haves

- Previous agency or content production experience

- Copywriting or direct-response marketing experience

- Experience analyzing social media performance data

- Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and storytelling

- Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Grok, Veo3, Kling, or similar tools

- Experience researching competitors, customers, and markets

- Strong understanding of internet culture and social media trends



What We Offer

- Stable, full-time remote role with consistent workload

- Access to all required AI and editing tools

- Copywriting, marketing, editing, and creative strategy resources

- Direct feedback and mentorship on your work

- Access to real performance data so you can understand what actually works

- Freedom to test ideas, experiment, and develop your own creative instincts

- Opportunity to develop skills across editing, AI, copywriting, data analysis, and strategy

- Growth opportunities as we scale

- Performance bonuses of up to 40% of monthly pay.



How to Apply



Include all of the following. INCOMPLETE APPLICATIONS WILL NOT BE REVIEWED:

- Start your application with the word “GROWTH”

- Portfolio or reel (Drive, Notion, or direct links)

- 2-3 of your best short-form content edits

- What AI tools have you used before?

- Short answer (3-5 sentences): If one of your videos significantly underperformed compared to the others, how would you figure out what went wrong and improve the next one?

- Short answer (3-5 sentences): Tell us about something you taught yourself without being asked. How did you learn it?

- Your timezone + working hours

No portfolio = no review.

title: Full-Time Social Media Manager & Content Operations
description:
Background



We’re a fast-growing short-form content agency managing multiple social media accounts across Instagram,
, TikTok, Threads, YouTube, and more. WE’RE SCALING FAST!!



We’re looking for someone to take ownership of the backend of our content operation - managing accounts, publishing content, maintaining quality, tracking performance, finding inspiration, and solving whatever bottlenecks are slowing the team down.



This is NOT just a posting role. We want someone who is proactive, hungry to improve, and wants to grow with the team long term.



What You'll Do



Social Media Management





- Create and set up Instagram,
, TikTok, Threads, and YouTube accounts

- Warm up new accounts and maintain healthy account activity

- Manage as many social media accounts as possible across multiple clients

- Manually publish content during EST working hours

- Make sure captions, videos, profiles, links, and account information are correct and up to date

- Monitor account health and flag issues immediately



Content Quality & Operations





- Review videos before they are posted and make sure they meet our standards

- Stay on top of editors and their assets to ensure quality and deadlines are being met

- Catch mistakes before content goes live

- Identify bottlenecks across the team and help solve them

- Keep assets, posting schedules, and accounts organized



Performance & Research





- Track the performance of all accounts and report key results back to the team

- Identify what content is performing and what needs improvement

- Scroll TikTok, Instagram,
, YouTube, Reddit, etc. to find new ideas and inspiration

- Find strong hooks, formats, trends, competitors, and content for editors and scriptwriters

- Continuously look for ways to improve our content and operations



Requirements



Must-Haves





- GROWTH MINDSET AND GENUINE HUNGER TO LEARN!!

- Strong English Proficiency (speaking, reading, writing)

- Extremely reliable and organized

- Strong attention to detail

- Comfortable managing many social media accounts at once

- Very familiar with Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, and other social platforms

- Able to work consistently during EST hours

- Comfortable manually posting content every day

- Able to identify problems and solve them without always waiting for instructions

- Comfortable giving feedback and holding team members accountable for quality

- Strong understanding of short-form social media content

- Reliable laptop/computer and internet connection

- Looking for a long-term role and willing to grow with the company



Nice-to-Haves





- Previous social media management experience

- Experience managing multiple client accounts

- Agency or content production experience

- Experience creating and warming up social media accounts

- Understanding of short-form performance, hooks, retention, and trends

- Experience managing editors, creators, or other team members

- Familiarity with Google Drive, Google Sheets, Slack, and project management tools



What We Offer





- Stable, full-time remote role

- Direct access to the team and fast feedback

- Training on our accounts, content standards, and workflows

- Opportunity to take on more responsibility as we scale

- Performance bonuses of up to 40% of monthly pay

- Access to required tools

- Long-term growth opportunities within the company



How to Apply



INCOMPLETE APPLICATIONS WILL NOT BE REVIEWED.

- Start your application with the word “GROWTH”

- Tell us about any social media accounts you've previously managed

We're not looking for someone who waits around for instructions. We want someone who sees a problem, takes ownership of it, and helps the entire team run better.

title: Claude AI Operator for a Shopify Fashion Brand | Build Our Support, Supplier & Reporting Automations
description:
WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We run a sub niche fashion brand on Shopify, selling across the Big Five markets, with fulfillment through an agent in China. We are looking for one person who runs our support inbox, keeps our supplier sharp, and builds the AI systems behind both: agents that prepare replies, dashboards and reporting that fill themselves from what comes in, and automations that catch problems before a customer does.



This is a building role with a support inbox attached, not the other way around. We work in Claude. If you have not set up agents, workflows or reporting in Claude yourself, this is not the role for you, however good you are at support.



WHAT YOU WILL BUILD



These are the first projects. You will own them.



- An agent that reads incoming customer
s and prepares the reply, so all a human does is check and send

- Dashboards and reporting that build themselves from the inbox: refund reasons, sizing issues, recurring product problems, supplier performance

- A supply check that flags orders sitting still too long and raises it with the agent before the customer writes in

- A product quality guarantee: checks that trigger after a set number of orders to confirm what the supplier ships still meets - our standard, and a clear process when it does not

- A dispute agent that kicks in when a chargeback comes in and gathers the evidence

- Stock alerts so we reach the agent before a product runs out



WHAT YOU WILL RUN



- The support inbox: order questions, tracking, delays, refunds, replacements, sizing, complaints

- Direct communication with our agent in China about orders, stock, quality, replacements and delays, followed through until it is actually solved

- Chargebacks and payment disputes, from gathering evidence to submitting the case

- Reviewing AI drafted replies and catching what the AI gets wrong before it reaches a customer



We provide the Claude account and workspace.



HARD REQUIREMENTS



Both are required. Please do not apply if you are missing one.



1. Hands-on Shopify dropshipping support with direct communication with Chinese suppliers or fulfillment agents. You know what long transit times, tracking that goes quiet and stock that runs out look like from the inside.

2. Advanced, hands-on experience with Claude. You have built agents, workflows, prompt systems or self-filling reports in Claude that you or others actually use. Experience with other AI tools is a plus, not a substitute. Using AI to polish
s does not count.



The only exception to point 2: if you have built something with another AI tool that is so strong we need to know about it, tell us exactly what it does and show it. Otherwise, without real Claude experience, we will not move forward.



STRONG PLUS



Advanced operations experience: 

1. you have owned quality control, supplier performance or refund reduction, not only the inbox

2. Fashion or apparel experience, especially sizing and returns

3. Chargeback and dispute handling



Also required: previous ecommerce support experience, strong written English, comfortable building in Google Sheets, Excel or Notion, and able to work independently from an SOP while thinking for yourself.



COMPENSATION



The base rate is $4 USD per hour, starting at 1 to 2 hours per day. That is the starting point, not the ceiling. Rate and hours grow as the automations you build start saving real time, and we agree the milestones for that together in your first week.



HOW TO APPLY



Answer these in your own words. Short and specific beats long and polished. No need to name previous stores or suppliers, we respect that.



1. Your Shopify dropshipping experience: what kind of products, what your day to day looked like, and how the communication with the Chinese supplier or agent worked.

2. What you have done with AI so far, and with Claude specifically. Which agents, workflows or reports you built, what they do, and who uses them.

3. How you make sure AI makes as few mistakes as possible. What you check, what you never let it d
 alone, and how you catch it when it goes wrong.

4. Your operations experience beyond the inbox: quality checks, supplier performance, refund reduction or similar, and what came out of it.

5. Whether you have experience with chargebacks and disputes, and if so, what your role was.

6. A screenshot or link of a report, dashboard or workflow you built. Client data removed is fine.

7. Your weekly availability.



Applications that are clearly one unedited AI answer, or that skip the questions, will not be considered.

Catch and fix AI hallucinations before anything leaves your desk, and keep every view of the same space consistent. 

• Accuracy to Spec: Make sure furniture and finishes in the final images match the real products: proportions, fabrics, wood grain, metal finishes. • Operating System: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) 

• Graphics Card (most important): NVIDIA RTX GPU with at least 12 GB VRAM (e.g., RTX 3060 12GB). RTX 4070 or better preferred 

• Processor: Intel Core i7 (recent generation) or better 

• Memory (RAM): 32 GB minimum, 64 GB preferred 

• Storage: 1 TB SSD (NVMe preferred)

title: Virtual Assistant - AirBnB Guest Communications Specialist
description:
AIRBNB GUEST COMMUNICATIONS SPECIALIST



We manage 15+ furnished rental units across the U.S. on AirBnB, VRBO, Booking.com, Expedia, Marriott, and more. We are a professional, systems-driven operation looking for experienced team members who already know how this industry works and can perform from day one.



This is not a beginner role. If you do not meet every requirement below, do not apply. Applications that do not qualify will be deleted without response.



ROLE DETAILS

[AM / PM] Shift — USA Pacific Time 

Full-time: 5 days/week or 6 days/week 

Pay: $500 to $800/month based on experience. Six-day schedules receive higher compensation.



REQUIREMENTS — YOU MUST MEET ALL OF THESE

- 3+ years of experience in short-term rental (STR) co-hosting, property management, or STR hospitality operations 

- You must have worked directly in a co-hosting, STR operations, or property management role supporting a portfolio of 50+ units 

- Hands-on experience with Hospitable

- Strong written and spoken English 

- Reliable internet, stable workspace, and full availability during your assigned shift



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We want someone who is detail-oriented, organized, and hospitality-driven. Someone who takes ownership of problems and solves them without being told to. Someone who can communicate with guests professionally under pressure, think clearly during difficult situations, and treat every interaction like it matters. If you need to be micromanaged, this is not the right fit.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Your main focus is front-end guest communication. This includes messaging and calling guests, managing check-ins and check-outs, coordinating maintenance, communicating with cleaners and handymen, following up on open issues, screening reservations, and supporting channel communications.



SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES

You will also assist with backend tasks including claims filing, review removal, responding to reviews, listing creation and updates, and daily task tracking. Guest communication always comes first.



TOOLS WE USE

Hospitable, PriceLabs, Enso Connect, Ecobee, SuiteOp, Quo, WhatsApp, Monday.com



HOW TO APPLY

Reply to this listing with everything below included. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.

- Your resume and a short message covering your total years in STR, the type of operation you worked for, and roughly how many units you managed or supported.



- A Loom video recorded at loom.com, between 3 and 5 minutes. Cover three things: your STR background and the types of operations you have worked for; walk through one specific difficult guest situation you personally handled and how you resolved it; and explain why you are applying to this role. Do not read from a script.



- Your written responses to the scenarios below. Take your time. This should take 20 to 30 minutes.



Scenario A: It is 11:30 PM. A guest sends this message: "The AC isn't working and it's 85 degrees in here. We have a baby. This is unacceptable. I want a full refund and I'm leaving a 1-star review." Your maintenance contact is not responding. The next available technician cannot come until 9 AM. Write the exact message you send to the guest right now. Write the exact message you send to the maintenance contact. Write what you log in the daily report. Then in 2 to 3 sentences, explain why you responded to the guest the way you did.



Scenario B: It is 8:30 AM at the start of your shift. You open your task board and see four things. One: a guest checking in today at 3 PM is requesting early check-in at noon and the unit is not cleaned yet. Two: a guest who checked out this morning left a complaint about a broken shower head. Three: a review from 3 days ago has not been responded to. Four: a new reservation just came in flagged by Autohost for review. List these in the order you would handle them and explain why.

Scenario C: A guest checks out and leaves a 3-star review that says: "Good location but the team was slow to respond." You personally replied to every message within 15 minutes during their stay. Write the public response you would post.

Qualified applicants will be contacted for an interview. All new hires begin with a one-month paid trial period.

title: Solana AI Launch Operator / Frontend Developer — Claude Code, React & Next.js
description:
JOB TITLE

Solana AI Launch Operator / Frontend Developer — Claude Code, React & Next.js



JOB TYPE

Gig / Project-based, with potential for ongoing repeat work.



ABOUT THE ROLE



I’m building a small Solana launch studio and looking for a fast, resourceful builder who can turn approved ideas into complete, polished launch packages.



We provide the idea, narrative research and creative direction. You handle the website, professional branding, X account creation, launch content, testing and handover.



This role requires strong frontend skills, good design judgment and the ability to manage production independently.



You’ll use Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or comparable AI tools to accelerate production while taking responsibility for the finished result.



Projects primarily include meme/narrative websites, with occasional lightweight utilities and dashboards using existing APIs.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Build polished, responsive websites using React/Next.js and reusable templates.

• Diagnose and fix AI-generated coding errors independently.

• Develop professional, consistent branding: logos, avatars, X headers, DEX Screener banners and website graphics.

• Propose suitable coin names and tickers for approval when requested.

• Create and configure the project’s X account, including its handle, display name, bio, profile image, header and website link.

• Write clear English website copy, a pinned launch post and short launch-day tweets.

• Prepare approved posts for scheduling or publication during the agreed launch window.

• Connect existing APIs or wallet functionality when included in the brief.

• Build and test any lightweight utility included in the agreed scope.

• Prepare token metadata and launch configuration for approved platforms.

• Deploy websites, configure domains and verify mobile/desktop layouts.

• Deliver organized source code, assets, account access and a concise handover.

• Improve reusable templates and communicate blockers promptly.



DESIGN & BRANDING EXPECTATIONS



Your work should look polished enough for a serious public crypto launch.



You must be able to create a professional logo and a coherent visual identity, then carry that identity across the website, X profile and launch graphics.



We will assess typography, spacing, mobile presentation, image quality, readability and consistency. AI-generated assets are welcome, but you must refine them and check the finished result.



Please apply only if you can personally handle both website production and the required branding/content work.



REQUIRED SKILLS



• Practical React/Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript and responsive CSS experience.

• Hands-on experience with AI coding tools.

• Ability to debug, test and deploy independently.

• Strong visual judgment, with examples of website and branding work.

• Clear written English for website copy and social content.

• Familiarity with X account creation and profile setup.

• Familiarity with GitHub, hosting and domain configuration.

• Practical familiarity with Solana tokens, token metadata, mint addresses, wallet connections, Pump.fun, Solscan and DEX Screener.

• Reliable communication during agreed project windows.



Previous crypto websites, complete launch packages or Solana wallet/API integrations are strongly preferred. Familiarity with Proxima or J7 is a bonus.



Be specific about what you have personally shipped and what you are still learning.



WHAT A FINISHED STANDARD PACKAGE INCLUDES



• A deployed website that works on mobile and desktop.

• Working navigation, buttons and all agreed functionality.

• Approved coin name, ticker, token details and links.

• A professional logo/avatar, X header, DEX Screener banner and agreed website graphics.

• Consistent branding across the website and social profile.

• A created and configured X account, with ownership and recovery access handed over.

• Website copy, an X bio, a pinned launch post and four short launch-day tweets.

• Prepared token metadata and launch configuration when included in the brief.

• Organized source code, editable assets where applicable and deployment handover.

• A short summary of completed work, outstanding items and recurring costs.



Features presented as live must work. Prototypes, simulations and planned features must be clearly labelled.



SPEED EXPECTATIONS



Once reusable templates, supported integrations and deployment processes are established, our target is approximately 2–3 hours for a standard template-based launch package.



This is a target to validate during the pilot. Applicants should propose realistic delivery times and identify anything that needs additional scope.



Initial template development, custom designs, new utilities, custom integrations, smart contracts and complex backend systems receive separate timelines and pricing.



Account verification, domain propagation and other external delays should be flagged promptly.



Quality, accuracy and actual completion matter alongside speed.



PAY & PROJECT STRUCTURE



• Target budget: $30–$50 USD per standard launch package using established templates.

• Paid three-hour trial: $40.

• Final package pricing agreed after the trial, based on scope and demonstrated delivery.

• Each project has agreed deliverables, a deadline and revision scope.

• Template development, custom functionality and ongoing maintenance are priced separately.

• Payment for agreed, completed work does not depend on token performance or whether the launch proceeds.

• Potential for ongoing repeat projects as the studio grows.



Approved software subscriptions, hosting, domains and transaction expenses are covered separately.



INTERVIEW & PAID TRIAL



Every shortlisted candidate must complete a 20-minute interview before the paid trial. You’ll be asked to walk through previous work and explain your contribution.



The trial evaluates your ability to produce a complete A–Z package for a potential token launch.



You’ll receive an approved brief, reference examples and an agreed starter template. During the three-hour session, you’ll work on:



• A working preview website and all agreed functionality.

• Coin name/ticker proposals where requested.

• A professional logo and consistent launch graphics.

• X account creation and profile setup using the agreed ownership process.

• Website copy, an X bio, a pinned post and four launch-day tweets.

• Token metadata and launch configuration where included.

• Source code, assets, QA and a brief handover.



The trial is paid regardless of whether you are selected. Final public release and real token deployment require my approval. You will not need to use personal wallet funds.



OWNERSHIP & AVAILABILITY



Source code, assets, domains, X accounts and deployment accounts must be accessible to me and handed over clearly. Account ownership and recovery must remain under my control.



I retain control of wallet credentials and final transaction signing. You prepare and verify launch configuration.



Please state your working hours in Philippine/Bali time (UTC+8), weekly availability, earliest start date and turnaround time during agreed launch windows.



HOW TO APPLY



Use the subject: Solana Launch Builder — [Your Name]



Please answer each point:



1. Share two live websites you personally built. Explain your exact contribution, tools/templates used and approximate build time.

2. Share one example of a logo or complete branding package you created. Explain which assets you produced yourself.

3. Describe your hands-on Solana experience and link relevant crypto projects. Clearly distinguish shipped work from familiarity.

4. Describe one specific AI-generated coding problem you diagnosed and fixed: what failed, how you found the cause and how you verified the fix.

5. Confirm whether you can independently handle X account creation, professional branding, English copy and launch-content preparation.

6. State your working hours, weekly availability and earliest start date.

7. Give a short, realistic three-hour delivery plan covering the website, branding, X setup, content, QA and handover.



Applications with relevant live work and specific answers will receive priority. Please identify team projects clearly and explain your personal contribution.

title: lead researcher
description:
ay: $2/hour + Performance Bonuses

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8 hours per day (40 hours/week)

Position: Full-Time Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED.



Do NOT apply if you have never sourced profitable products for Amazon FBA before. I am specifically looking for someone who already understands Amazon product sourcing and can work independently.



You should already know how to analyze Amazon listings, research suppliers, verify websites, check sellers and competition, calculate profit, and determine whether a product is actually worth purchasing.



YOUR MAIN JOB



You must provide 5 VALID ASINs per day.



That equals 25 valid ASINs per week.



Finding 5 random products does NOT count. Products must meet ALL of my requirements and pass my review.



If some of your daily ASINs are rejected, you have until the end of the week/payday to replace them and reach the required 25 valid ASINs.



25 approved ASINs per week is the minimum requirement — not just 25 submissions.



BONUSES 💰



I reward VAs who consistently provide good leads and help me grow the business.



You can earn additional bonuses for:



Consistently finding valid ASINs: If your leads regularly pass my review and meet all requirements, you can receive performance bonuses.



More than 25 approved ASINs: If you finish your required 25 valid ASINs early and continue finding additional approved products, you can receive a bonus for exceeding your weekly target.



Finding profitable Amazon seller storefronts: If you discover a strong Online Arbitrage seller storefront that I can use for further product research, submit the storefront to me. If I review it and approve it as a good sourcing opportunity, you can receive a bonus.



High-quality sourcing: VAs who consistently find products that I actually purchase and successfully sell will have opportunities for additional bonuses and higher pay over time.



Quality still matters. Adding random ASINs just to go above 25 will NOT earn a bonus. Extra ASINs must meet the same requirements as your normal submissions and pass my review.



PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS



Every product you submit must:



Be a brand I am already approved/ungated to sell



Make at least $2 profit per unit



Have at least 50 estimated sales per month



NOT be a generic brand



Have realistic competition where I can actually get sales



Have enough room for me to enter the listing without immediately destroying the price



Come from a REAL, TRUSTWORTHY SOURCE



Be in stock and actually available to purchase



Match the EXACT Amazon product/variation



Include the correct source link



Include the correct Amazon ASIN/listing



Not already have been submitted by another VA on my team



ROI is NOT my main requirement. I care more about actual dollar profit, sales volume, competition, and whether I can realistically sell the inventory.



QUANTITY MATTERS



Do NOT submit deals that only become profitable when purchasing an unrealistic quantity.



Example:



If a product only meets my requirements when buying 25 units, but the Amazon listing only sells around 50 units per month and has 20 competing sellers, I am obviously not going to purchase 25 units.



Use common sense.



Look at:



Monthly sales + number of sellers + competition + minimum purchase quantity.



The deal needs to make sense for MY business, not just look profitable on a spreadsheet.



SOURCE VERIFICATION IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You MUST verify every website before submitting it.



I recently had a VA provide a fake website that looked like a major retailer. A purchase was made from the website and the card information was compromised.



That cannot happen again.



Before submitting ANY unfamiliar website, verify that it is legitimate.



Do NOT submit:



Fake retailer websites



Scam websites



Copycat websites



Suspicious Shopify stores



Random websites with no established reputation



Sources you have not properly researched



A retailer/distributor different from the one you put in the spreadsheet



If you are unsure whether a source is legitimate, DO NOT SUBMIT IT. Ask me first.



QUALITY > RANDOM LEADS



I would rather receive 5 strong ASINs than 20 bad ones.



Do not fill the spreadsheet just to hit your number.



Repeatedly submitting products that clearly violate the requirements will result in termination.



YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW



You should have previous experience with:



Amazon Seller Central



Amazon FBA



Online Arbitrage



Product sourcing



Keepa



SellerAmp SAS or similar tools



Buy Box analysis



Sales rank / estimated monthly sales



Amazon fees



Profit calculations



Seller/competition analysis



Variation matching



Source verification



Checking whether Amazon is on the listing



Identifying dangerous price drops or listings with too much competition



Amazon seller storefront sourcing / storefront stalking



You should NOT need me to teach you the basics of Amazon sourcing.



HOURS



Monday–Friday

8 hours per day

40 hours per week



This is a long-term position for the right person.



Starting pay is $2/hour, but strong performance can earn you bonuses and opportunities for increased pay.



The better the products you find and the more value you bring to the business, the more opportunity you have to earn.



HOW TO APPLY



Do NOT send me a generic copy-and-paste application.



Start your application with:



“I HAVE AMAZON SOURCING EXPERIENCE”



Then answer these questions:



How long have you been sourcing products for Amazon?



Have you done Online Arbitrage before?



What sourcing tools have you used?



Do you know how to use Keepa? Explain what you normally check on a Keepa chart.



Do you know how to use SellerAmp SAS?



How do you determine whether there are too many sellers on a listing?



How do you verify that a sourcing website is legitimate?



How do you determine how many units of a product you would recommend buying?



What is the difference between profit and ROI?



Have you used Amazon seller storefronts to find additional profitable products? Explain your process.



Send an example of an Amazon sourcing spreadsheet you have worked with before, with any confidential client information removed.



FINAL TEST: Include one example ASIN + source link that you believe would be worth researching for Online Arbitrage. Briefly explain why you chose it.



If you cannot answer these questions, please do not apply.



I am looking for someone who already knows what they are doing, pays attention to details, follows instructions, verifies their sources, and can consistently find products that I can actually buy and sell.

title: Aprinta — Print Purchasing & Order Specialist
description:
Location: Remote

Department: Purchasing & Order Operations

Position Type: Full-Time

Reports To: Aprinta Operations



About Aprinta



Aprinta is a growing branded products platform helping businesses manage promotional products, custom apparel, commercial printing, company stores, packaging, kitting and fulfillment.



We are building an operations team that can efficiently manage customer orders from purchase through production and delivery.



We are looking for a Print Purchasing & Order Specialist who can take ownership of commercial printing orders and work directly with our production vendors.



The Position



This is not a basic data-entry or virtual assistant position.



You will be responsible for helping manage Aprinta's commercial print orders from the time an order is approved until the finished product is delivered.



You will work with printers and production partners to obtain pricing, source products, issue purchase orders, coordinate artwork and proofs, track production, solve problems and ensure orders are completed correctly and on time.



The ideal candidate has previous experience in commercial printing, print purchasing, print estimating, print production, procurement or print order management.



Key Responsibilities

Order Management

Review incoming customer orders for completeness and accuracy.

Verify product specifications, quantities, dimensions, materials, finishing requirements, artwork and delivery dates.

Identify missing or conflicting information before production begins.

Assign orders to appropriate production vendors.

Maintain accurate order status throughout the production process.

Track every order from purchase through delivery.

Purchasing & Vendor Management

Request pricing from approved print vendors.

Compare vendor pricing, production capabilities and turnaround times.

Negotiate pricing when appropriate.

Identify the best vendor based on price, quality, capabilities and delivery requirements.

Create and submit purchase orders.

Confirm vendor acknowledgements and pricing.

Maintain accurate vendor pricing information.

Help identify and qualify new production partners.

Develop backup vendors for important product categories.

Print Production



Candidates should understand or be willing to quickly learn common print specifications including:



Paper stocks and weights

Coated and uncoated stocks

Digital printing

Offset printing

Wide-format printing

Signs and banners

Labels and stickers

Packaging

PMS and process color

Bleeds and safe areas

Finishing

Folding

Binding

Lamination

Die cutting

Mailing and fulfillment

Artwork & Proof Management

Submit production-ready artwork to vendors.

Obtain electronic or production proofs.

Compare proofs against the original order.

Verify dimensions, colors, quantities, finishing and other specifications.

Coordinate corrections when required.

Ensure production does not proceed until required approvals are received.

Production & Shipping

Monitor production schedules.

Confirm expected ship dates.

Follow up proactively with vendors.

Identify potential delays before they become customer problems.

Obtain tracking information.

Confirm orders ship to the correct destination.

Escalate urgent production or shipping issues.

Problem Resolution



Take ownership when something goes wrong.



This may include:



Incorrect printing

Damaged products

Quantity shortages

Late production

Incorrect specifications

Shipping problems

Artwork issues

Quality problems



Work with vendors to obtain reprints, credits, refunds or other appropriate resolutions.



Cost & Margin Control

Verify vendor invoices against purchase orders.

Record actual production costs.

Identify pricing discrepancies.

Look for opportunities to reduce purchasing costs.

Help maintain Aprinta's target gross margins.

Continually evaluate whether Aprinta is receiving competitive vendor pricing.

What We're Looking For



Preference will be given to candidates with previous experience working for:



Commercial printers

Printing brokers

Print management companies

Promotional product distributors

Packaging companies

Purchasing departments

Print production departments



You should be:



Extremely organized

Detail-oriented

Comfortable managing multiple orders simultaneously

Strong with spreadsheets and web-based systems

Comfortable communicating with U.S. vendors by email and phone

Able to negotiate professionally

Comfortable working independently

Proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do

Able to identify problems and escalate them quickly

Success in This Role



You will be measured on:



Order accuracy

On-time production and delivery

Purchasing savings

Gross-margin protection

Order turnaround time

Vendor performance

Error rate

Problem resolution

Accuracy of order records

Number of orders requiring management intervention



Our goal is simple:



Once an order is assigned to you, you own it until it is successfully delivered.



How to Apply



Please include:



A summary of your relevant experience.

Any commercial printing experience you have.

The types of printed products you have purchased or managed.

Your experience obtaining and comparing vendor quotes.

Your experience issuing purchase orders.

Your experience reviewing artwork or print proofs.

The software or order-management systems you have used.

Your current availability.

title: Wildlife Photography Editer
description:
I’m a UK-based wildlife photographer who travels around the world photographing animals in the wild, on safaris and in wildlife parks.



I’m looking for a talented, reliable photo editor to help me take my wildlife photography to the next level.



This is NOT a general photo editing position.



I’m specifically looking for somebody who has experience editing wildlife and animal photography, understands how to bring out the best in animal subjects, and has an exceptional eye for detail.



My photographs include everything from big cats and elephants to birds, marine wildlife and other animals photographed in different environments and lighting conditions.



The edited images will initially be used on a growing wildlife-focused social media account, with longer-term plans to develop a range of photography products, including prints, calendars and potentially other merchandise.



I’m looking for somebody who would enjoy being involved in this journey long term, rather than simply completing a few edits.



What I’m looking for



You MUST have strong experience using both:



* Adobe Lightroom / Lightroom Classic

* Adobe Photoshop



Advanced masking skills are absolutely essential.



I want somebody who can look at a wildlife photograph and understand exactly which adjustments will improve it without making the animal or environment look unnatural.



For example, you should be confident with:



* Advanced subject and background masking

* Precisely masking animals, including difficult areas such as fur, feathers, whiskers and fine details

* Selectively adjusting exposure, shadows and highlights

* Enhancing animal eyes naturally without making them look artificial

* Improving fur, feather and skin detail

* Managing noise in photographs taken at high ISO

* Sharpening wildlife images without introducing unwanted artefacts

* Adjusting colours while maintaining realistic animal appearances

* Improving distracting backgrounds without making them look fake

* Removing minor distractions where appropriate

* Creating consistent edits across a collection of photographs

* Using Photoshop for more advanced corrections where Lightroom alone isn’t sufficient



I particularly value editors who understand that sometimes the best editing is subtle editing.



I’m not looking for oversaturated colours, excessive sharpening, artificial-looking eyes or photographs that have been edited beyond recognition.



The animals should remain the focus of the image.



Wildlife photography experience is essential



Please only apply if you have genuine experience editing wildlife or animal photography.



Experience editing portraits, weddings, landscapes, products or general social media photographs is not enough on its own.



Wildlife photography presents different challenges, particularly when dealing with:



* Animals photographed in difficult lighting conditions

* Busy natural backgrounds

* Fast-moving subjects

* Fine feather and fur details

* High ISO images

* Subjects partially hidden by vegetation

* Maintaining realistic colours and textures



I want somebody who understands these challenges and enjoys working with wildlife images.



You don’t necessarily need to be a wildlife photographer yourself, but you should understand what makes a strong wildlife photograph.



What the work will involve



Initially, I expect to need approximately 2 hours of editing per week.



I will provide the original RAW photographs, along with occasional guidance on the style or finish I’m looking for.



Your responsibilities will include:



1. Selecting and applying appropriate adjustments in Lightroom.

2. Using detailed masking to improve subjects and backgrounds independently.

3. Using Photoshop where more advanced editing is required.

4. Producing polished, high-quality images suitable for Instagram and
.

5. Maintaining a consistent, natural editing style.

6. Exporting photographs in the requested formats and resolutions.

7. Keeping the original RAW files untouched and providing editable files when requested.

8. Communicating clearly and meeting agreed deadlines.



I would also welcome suggestions about how individual photographs could be improved.



I’m not looking for somebody who simply applies the same preset to every image.



Long-term opportunities



Although this position will begin with approximately 2 hours per week, I’m hoping to build a long-term working relationship with the right person.



As the social media account continues to grow, there is potential for additional editing hours and more regular work.



My longer-term ambition is to sell wildlife photography prints, calendars and other photography products.



If this becomes successful, I would be very happy to discuss a profit-sharing arrangement with the editor who has helped develop the images and contributed to the project’s success.



This would be separate from the agreed hourly payment and would be something we discuss properly as the project develops.



I’d love to find somebody who is genuinely interested in wildlife photography and would enjoy seeing their work contribute to something that grows over time.



How to apply – please read carefully



I receive a lot of applications, so I’ve included some specific instructions to help identify people who have taken the time to read the full advert.



Your application MUST begin with the word “mask” (all lowercase).



It must be the very first word of your application.



Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be considered.



Please then include the following:



1. Introduce yourself



Tell me a little about yourself, your editing background and why you’re interested in working specifically with wildlife photography.



2. Show me your wildlife editing experience



Please provide a portfolio containing at least 3–5 examples of wildlife or animal photographs you have personally edited.



I would strongly prefer to see BEFORE and AFTER versions so I can understand exactly what improvements you made.



General portrait, wedding or product editing portfolios will not be sufficient.



3. Explain your masking experience



Tell me about your experience using masking in Lightroom and Photoshop.



In particular, explain how you would approach editing an animal with fine fur or feathers against a complicated background.



I want to understand your actual editing process, not just read a list of software features.



4. Tell me about your editing workflow



Do you use Lightroom Classic, Lightroom, Photoshop or a combination?



How do you move between the programmes, and what types of adjustments do you prefer to complete in each?



5. Explain your approach to natural-looking wildlife photography



How do you enhance an animal’s eyes, detail and colours without making the photograph look overedited?



Please give a specific example from your own editing experience.



6. Confirm your availability



Please confirm that you are comfortable starting with approximately 2 hours per week at $6.88 USD per hour, with the possibility of increasing hours over time.



7. Include the word “feathers”



Somewhere in your answer to question 5, please naturally include the word “feathers”.



This is simply another way for me to see that you have read the instructions carefully.



Next stage – practical editing test



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a small practical editing task using one of my own wildlife RAW photographs.



The task will be designed to assess:



* Lightroom and Photoshop ability

* Precision of masking

* Natural colour correction

* Eye for detail

* Understanding of wildlife photography

* Overall quality of the finished image



I will provide the same photograph to shortlisted applicants so I can compare editing styles fairly.



Full details will be shared with those selected.



Finally



I’m looking for somebody who takes pride in their work, notices the small details and genuinely enjoys editing photographs of animals.



If you love wildlife photography, have excellent Lightroom and Photoshop skills, and would like to become part of a growing project, I’d really like to hear from you.



Please make sure you follow ALL the application instructions.



I look forward to seeing your work.

title: High Paying Static Ads Designer for 8-figure DTC Brand
description:
We are looking for a highly creative Static Ad Editor who understands direct response advertising and can create high-performing static ads for Meta.



This role is not just about making ads look good. You need to understand why an ad works, how to match the creative to the customer’s awareness level, and how to write clear, direct, emotionally relevant copy that makes someone stop scrolling.



You will be responsible for creating static image ads from concept to final design, including the headline, supporting copy, layout, image direction, and overall creative execution.



Responsibilities

- Create static ads for Meta that are designed to drive clicks, conversions, and profitable customer acquisition

- Develop new ad concepts based on customer pain points, emotions, product benefits, and proven direct response angles

- Write your own ad copy, including hooks, headlines, subheadlines, callouts, and supporting text

- Understand and apply the 3 key customer awareness levels when creating ads:



Trigger Awareness: The customer is feeling a problem but may not fully understand what is causing it yet

Exploration Awareness: The customer is actively looking for answers, explanations, or possible solutions

Evaluation Awareness: The customer understands the problem and is comparing products, mechanisms, benefits, or offers



- Create ads that match the customer’s current mindset instead of using generic headlines

- Turn creative briefs, customer research, and product angles into strong static ad concepts

- Work with the creative team to test new hooks, visual formats, angles, and messaging styles

- Analyze winning ads and understand the creative strategy behind them

- Create variations of winning concepts without simply copying the same ad repeatedly

- Ensure the final static ads are clean, easy to read, visually strong, and aligned with the brand

- Balance strong direct response messaging with tasteful, compliant, and brand-appropriate execution



Requirements

- Have previously worked for 8-9 figure DTC Brands

- Experience creating static ads for supplements, wellness, beauty, or similar direct response brands

- Strong understanding of Meta ads and what makes someone stop scrolling

- Ability to write clear, compelling ad copy without relying on a copywriter for every concept

- Strong understanding of customer awareness levels and how messaging changes at each stage

- Ability to create ads that speak directly to customer problems, desires, objections, and emotions

- Strong design sense, including layout, hierarchy, typography, spacing, and visual clarity

- Ability to create multiple ad concepts quickly while maintaining quality

- Comfortable receiving feedback and improving concepts based on performance data

- Strong attention to detail

- Familiarity with Canva, Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar design tools

- Understanding of direct response principles is a major plus



What We Are Looking For

- We want someone who can think like a creative strategist, write like a direct response marketer, and design like a performance-focused editor.

- The right person should be able to look at a product angle and create multiple static ad concepts that are visually engaging, emotionally specific, and written for the right awareness level.

- You should not need every headline handed to you. You should be able to study the customer, understand what they are feeling, and turn that into strong static ads that can be tested on Meta.



Bonus Points

- Experience with women’s wellness, supplements, beauty, postpartum, or health-related products

- Experience creating ads for high-spend Meta ad accounts

- Ability to break down why an ad works or does not work

- Ability to use AI tools to speed up concepting, copywriting, and design iteration

- Understanding of direct response frameworks, hooks, mechanisms, objections, and offer positioning

description:
Inbound Sales Representative – Home Services



We are looking for an experienced sales representative to join our team and sell home services to inbound leads.



This is not an entry-level sales position. We are looking for someone who already knows how to speak with homeowners, understand their needs, build trust quickly, overcome objections, follow up consistently, and close deals.



You will be speaking with customers who have already expressed interest in our services. Your job is to turn those opportunities into booked and paid jobs.



Responsibilities:

Respond quickly to inbound phone, web, and other leads

Speak with homeowners about their project and understand exactly what they need

Explain our services and pricing clearly

Build trust and confidently guide customers toward purchasing

Handle common objections around price, timing, competitors, and project details

Follow up with leads who do not purchase immediately

Keep accurate notes and update lead statuses in our CRM

Meet sales and conversion targets

Communicate with the operations team when needed to ensure a smooth customer experience



Requirements:

Previous sales experience is required

Strong preference for experience selling home services, construction, HVAC, landscaping, roofing, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, junk removal, materials, or similar services

Proven ability to close inbound leads

Excellent spoken and written English

Confident and natural on the phone

Strong objection-handling and follow-up skills

Comfortable discussing pricing and asking for the sale

Organized and able to manage multiple leads simultaneously

Reliable internet connection and professional working environment

Comfortable using CRMs, phone systems,
, and messaging tools



What We're Looking For:

We want someone who thinks like a salesperson, not an order taker.



A good candidate understands that an inbound inquiry is an opportunity that needs to be worked. You should be comfortable asking questions, identifying what matters to the customer, addressing concerns, creating urgency when appropriate, and directly asking the customer to move forward.



Experience and results matter more to us than formal education.



REQUIRED: Video Introduction



Applications without a video will not be considered.



Please submit a 2–3 minute video recording introducing yourself and answering the following:



Tell us about your previous sales experience.

What products or services have you sold?

Have you sold home services or worked with homeowners before?

Were the leads inbound, outbound, or both?

What were your typical sales targets or results?

Give us an example of how you would respond to a customer who says, "Your price is too high. I need to think about it."

Why do you think you would be good at this role?



Please speak naturally. We are using the video primarily to evaluate your communication skills, English, confidence, and sales ability, not your video production skills.



How to Apply



Send us:

Your resume

Your video introduction

A short description of your most relevant sales experience

The types of products or services you have sold

Any sales numbers, close rates, quotas, or other performance metrics you can share



Again, sales experience and the video introduction are mandatory. Applications without both will be automatically rejected.

title: Part-Time Podcast Publishing & Growth Coordinator
description:
Part-Time Podcast Publishing & Growth Coordinator



Relationship Renovation | Remote, Philippines | $5–8 USD/hour | Initial 90-day paid pilot



We’re looking for a reliable coordinator to carry each Relationship Renovation podcast episode from editor follow-up through publication and promotion. You’ll keep releases moving, check the details and run a small growth workflow that helps listeners discover useful episodes and connect with our approved offers.



Hours and working arrangement



Part-time, with weekly hours agreed after reviewing the publishing workflow. Our initial planning allowance is 4–6 hours weekly, subject to adjustment for the expanded scope.



Work is mostly asynchronous, with agreed release deadlines and a brief weekly meeting or written update. The expanded scope may need more than the initial allowance; we’ll agree workload, paid setup and weekly hours before work begins. Additional hours require agreement. Selection includes a small paid finalist assignment and a two-week paid working trial before the full pilot.



What you will own



- After E.J. sends an episode to the editors, follow up on finished audio and track the handoff. Listen to the finished episode for obvious technical or completeness problems and return substantive fixes to the editor.



- Generate the transcript and check it against the audio, including names, meaning, accuracy and obvious errors. Prepare and verify the title, show notes, links, approved business CTA and relevant catalog recommendation.



- Upload and schedule the release in RedCircle under the agreed standards, coordinate newsletter copy, links and deadlines directly with John, organize release promotion, verify publication and handle routine publishing fixes within agreed standards. Keep the release checklist and calendar current.



- Prepare one weekly promotion package: listener problem and benefit, copy for one
 placement and one agreed social channel, one catalog recommendation and one approved business CTA with a tracked link. Coordinate with existing team members so work is not duplicated.



- Build three problem-based catalog listening paths and promote one older episode weekly. Coordinate owned dynamic-ad messaging and timing with the person implementing the ads.



- Maintain a simple scorecard for mature first-week launches, a fixed catalog set, available engagement, tracked links and podcast-related enquiries. Run one manageable growth experiment at a time, with a short weekly update and recommendation.



Decisions and boundaries



Work from an episode brief, templates and agreed publishing standards. E.J. retains editorial direction, recording, business priorities and growth guidance. He reviews initial packages; the intended ongoing workflow is approval by exception. Escalate sensitive content, significant editorial changes, new spending and changes to offer messaging. Ops Dot supports drafts, analysis and planning when engaged; you verify accuracy and own completion.



This role excludes substantive audio/video editing, all-platform social management, website development, paid advertising, sales calls and booking two additional guests monthly. Existing production and social owners retain their work. Flag missing inputs or workload problems early; do not silently expand the role.



What matters and how to apply



Strong written English, dependable follow-through, careful listening and link checks, basic publishing/marketing coordination, spreadsheets and thoughtful AI use. Podcast or RedCircle experience helps; evidence of independent execution and learning matters more than tool familiarity. The operational test is whether E.J. can hand off a recording and have an accurate, properly promoted episode go live without chasing anyone. Growth and business attribution remain core objectives; no result is guaranteed.



Answer the five questions below briefly and include one existing relevant sample or a short description. Keep unpaid application work to about 15 minutes; no custom campaign is required.



Five screening questions



Pay depends on relevant experience and demonstrated ability. Existing or redacted examples are sufficient.



1. Describe a podcast or similar publishing workflow you personally carried from handoff to release. What did you own, how did you verify the finished result, and what did you handle without prompting? Include one existing writing or publishing sample, or a short description if it is confidential.



2. You receive finished audio and an AI transcript. How would you check audio completeness, speaker or guest names, transcript accuracy, title, show notes, links and CTA before scheduling? What would you fix yourself and what would you return to the editor or E.J.?



3. The editor is late and John needs newsletter copy before the release. How would you protect the deadline, keep people informed and d
 when E.J. needs to be involved? Explain how you would keep agreed growth work from disappearing behind publishing tasks.



4. A release is two days old, last week’s has seven days of downloads, and tracked clicks increased without clear enquiry attribution. What would you report, avoid concluding and test next in one manageable growth experiment?



5. What weekly hours can you reliably reserve, including a full listen to each episode and release-day checks? Give your Philippines-time availability, earliest start, relevant publishing-tool experience and how you use and verify AI-assisted work. We will agree final hours after reviewing the workflow.
