title: Experienced Property Manager - Virtual Assistant
description:
Location: Remote / Work From Home

Working Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM AEST (Brisbane Time)

Employment Type: Full-Time, Exclusive Position

Salary: Highly Competitive – Negotiable Based on Experience



About the Role



We are an Australian-based commercial property management business overseeing a portfolio of retail and commercial properties across Australia and New Zealand.



We are looking for an experienced, highly organised and dependable Property Management Virtual Assistant to join our team on a full-time, long-term basis.



This position is suited to someone who takes pride in their work, has exceptional attention to detail and can confidently manage day-to-day responsibilities without constant supervision.



We are not looking for an entry-level virtual assistant. Previous professional property management experience is essential.



We are willing to pay a premium salary to secure the right candidate who can demonstrate exceptional communication skills, reliability and the ability to work independently.



Key Responsibilities



You will assist with the daily management and administration of our commercial property portfolio, including:



Tenant Communication: Monitor and manage the company inbox, respond to tenant enquiries and maintain professional communication via
 and telephone.



Maintenance Coordination: Receive maintenance requests, communicate with contractors, obtain quotes, schedule works and follow up to ensure all issues are resolved.



Invoicing: Prepare, review and issue rental and outgoing invoices, ensuring accuracy and timely distribution.



Arrears Management: Monitor outstanding balances and follow up with tenants regarding overdue payments.



General Property Administration: Maintain accurate tenant records, property information and relevant documentation.



Lease Administration: Assist with monitoring lease expiries, rent reviews and other important tenancy dates.



Issue Resolution: Independently investigate and resolve routine tenant and property-related issues, escalating matters to management when necessary.



Task Management: Take full ownership of assigned tasks, following through from the initial request until the matter is satisfactorily resolved.



Essential Requirements



To be considered for this position, applicants must meet the following requirements:



1. Previous Property Management Experience

- Minimum of 2 years' professional property management experience.

- A strong understanding of property management processes, tenant communication, maintenance coordination and administrative responsibilities.





2. Exceptional English Communication Skills

- Excellent spoken and written English is essential.

- Must be confident communicating with Australian and New Zealand tenants, contractors and suppliers over the telephone.

- Ability to write clear, professional and grammatically accurate
s.

- Strong listening and comprehension skills.



3. Strong Attention to Detail

- Extremely high level of accuracy when preparing invoices, reviewing information and managing tenant correspondence.

- Ability to identify discrepancies, errors and potential issues before they become problems.

- Consistent commitment to producing high-quality work.



4. Independent Working & Problem-Solving

- Proven ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Strong initiative and a proactive approach to daily responsibilities.

- Ability to assess situations, identify practical solutions and make sound decisions within established guidelines.

- Understand when issues can be resolved independently and when management approval or escalation is required.



5. Ownership & Accountability

- Take responsibility for tasks from beginning to end.

- Follow up proactively with tenants, contractors and other parties without needing constant reminders.

- Maintain accurate records of outstanding matters and ensure tasks are completed within appropriate timeframes.

- Demonstrate reliability, accountability and a strong work ethic.



6. Full-Time Availability & Exclusivity



-Must be available to work Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM AEST (Brisbane Time).

- This is an exclusive full-time position. Applicants must not be working for any other companies, clients or employers during their engagement with us.

- Must be able to consistently commit to the required schedule.



7. Reliable Equipment & Working Environment

- Own a reliable computer suitable for daily administrative work.

- Have a fast and stable internet connection capable of supporting regular voice calls and online property management software.

- Access to a quiet, professional working environment suitable for telephone communication.



Highly Desirable (Not Essential):



- Familiarity with commercial retail leases, rental invoicing, outgoings and rent reviews.

- Experience using Re-Leased, Xero or similar property management and accounting software.

- Previous experience coordinating maintenance contractors and managing tenant enquiries.

- Professional references from previous property management employers.



What We Offer



Highly competitive remuneration: We are prepared to pay above typical VA rates for an outstanding candidate.



Long-term stability: A full-time role with the opportunity to establish a lasting working relationship.



Autonomy: The opportunity to take genuine responsibility for daily property management operations.



Direct communication: Work closely with business management in a professional and supportive environment.



Professional development: Opportunities to expand your responsibilities as you become familiar with our property portfolio and operations.



How to Apply



To ensure we identify candidates who are genuinely suited to this position, please include the following in your application:



Resume/CV: Detailing your previous property management experience, including the types of properties you have managed.



Experience Summary: Briefly describe your day-to-day responsibilities in your previous property management roles.



English Voice Recording: Submit a 60–90 second recording introducing yourself and explaining your property management experience.



Software Experience: List the property management and accounting platforms you are familiar with.



Salary Expectations: Specify your expected monthly salary in AUD.



Availability Confirmation: Confirm that you can work exclusively for our business from 9:00 AM–5:00 PM AEST, Monday–Friday.



Previous employer references are preferred but not mandatory.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to participate in a video interview and a paid practical assessment designed to evaluate communication skills, problem-solving ability, attention to detail and property management knowledge.



We are seeking a reliable, capable and motivated professional who wants to become a valued long-term member of our business.



If you have genuine property management experience, excellent English communication skills and the confidence to work independently, we encourage you to apply.

title: Elite Operations VA, ShipHero WMS & 3PL Support ($5/hour, full-time)
description:
About us:

Pine Path Logistics is a US-based 3PL fulfillment company. We store, pick, pack and ship products for ecommerce brands and TikTok Shop sellers, and we run our warehouse on ShipHero.



Who we're looking for

This role is for someone who:



- Takes ownership and finishes tasks without being chased

- Catches mistakes before they cause problems

- Is a quick learner who figures things out on their own (help docs, testing, research) before asking

- Communicates clearly and proactively, including when something is wrong



You don't need to know everything on day one. We provide training and ongoing support. We're looking for someone smart and eager to learn, with some baseline knowledge of warehouse management systems and 3PL operations.



What you'll do



ShipHero WMS



- Store setup: Connect and configure client stores (Shopify, TikTok Shop, Amazon and others), and fix sync or integration problems.

- Shipping methods: Set up and maintain carrier accounts, shipping methods and shipping-method mapping for each client.

- Product management: Create and update SKUs, kits/bundles, barcodes, weights and dimensions.

- Automation rules: Build and troubleshoot rules for order routing, carrier/service selection, tags, holds and packing instructions.

- Inventory: Monitor inventory levels, process adjustments and reconcile mismatches.

- Purchase orders and receiving: Create POs for incoming client inventory so the warehouse can receive against them, including lot and batch codes where required. Flag any inbound shipment that's missing a PO.

- Billing: Set up and maintain billing rules for each client, and prepare monthly billing reports.

- Reporting: Pull ShipHero reports as needed, such as inventory, orders and shipping.



Sales and admin



- CRM: We don't use a CRM yet but plan to add one. Once it's in place, you'll handle data entry: adding and updating contacts, companies and deals, logging notes, and keeping records clean.

- Proposals and contracts: Help draft client proposals, pricing quotes and service agreements.

- DocuSign: Prepare and send contracts for signature.

- General support: Help set up new clients in our systems and document processes as you go.



Requirements



- Proven experience as a VA, ideally in ecommerce, logistics or operations

- Experience with ecommerce platforms such as Shopify or TikTok Shop

- Exceptional attention to detail. Small data errors cause shipping and billing mistakes.

- Excellent written English for proposals, contracts and internal communication

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for bulk updates

- Fast, reliable internet

- Available for at least 4 hours of overlap with US Pacific business hours (exact schedule can be discussed)



Preferred:



- Baseline knowledge of warehouse management systems (WMS) such as ShipHero, ShipStation or Extensiv, and of 3PL operations

- Experience with a CRM such as HubSpot

- Experience with DocuSign or writing proposals

- Experience with lot/batch tracking (food, beverage or supplements)



Details:



Hours: Full-time

Pay: $5 per hour

Start date: ASAP

Training: Provided, with ongoing support



How to apply



Please follow these instructions carefully. Following directions is part of the evaluation, and applications that skip any step won't be reviewed.



1. Include the word "Apple" in your application's subject line or title.

2. Attach a screenshot of your internet speed test from speedtest.net.

3. Record a short Loom video (2–3 minutes) introducing yourself and walking us through your relevant experience, including any work with warehouse management systems, ecommerce platforms or operations and admin.

4. Include your available working hours in Pacific Time.

title: Detail-oriented Bookkeeper – Full-Time | Remote | AU
description:
We are looking for an experienced, highly organised and exceptionally detail-oriented end-to-end Bookkeeper to join a fast-paced Australian business.



This is a hands-on role for someone who stays on top of things in real time. You will be responsible for keeping financial records accurate and current throughout the day, monitoring incoming communications, reconciling accounts, identifying discrepancies and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



We operate in a high-pressure, fast-moving environment, so we need someone who can keep up, remain accurate under pressure and proactively follow through on outstanding matters without needing constant reminders.



What You'll Do

- Complete daily bank and account reconciliations as a priority.

- Monitor the accounts inbox throughout the working day and action financial matters promptly.

- Monitor incoming customer payments and ensure invoices are marked as paid as soon as payment is received and verified.

- Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.

- Prepare weekly payroll including setting up new staff in Xero.

- Process, check and allocate supplier invoices and customer payments accurately.

- Record foreign currency invoices.

- Monitor overdue invoices and proactively follow up outstanding payments.

- Identify and investigate duplicate payments, incorrect invoices, overpayments, underpayments and other discrepancies.

- Cross-check information rather than assuming transactions or records are correct.

- Review courier/freight invoices and compare actual charges against quoted freight and freight charged to customers.

- Identify unexpected charges, discrepancies and potential underquoting.

- Liaise with our accountant and respond to requests promptly.

- Maintain clear notes and accurate financial records.

- Follow outstanding matters through until they are fully resolved, not simply identified.

- Proactively flag anything unusual to management.



What We're Looking For

You must be someone who is:

- Extremely detail-oriented. Small discrepancies matter in this role.

- Able to work accurately in a fast-paced and high-pressure environment.

- Proactive and able to identify what needs attention without waiting to be told.

- Comfortable monitoring
s, payments and financial activity throughout the day.

- Able to prioritise urgent financial matters while still completing routine responsibilities.

- Confident in investigating discrepancies using the information and systems available to you.

- Comfortable asking questions when something doesn't look right.

- Strong at following up. If something remains unresolved, we expect you to keep it on your radar.

- Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities.

- Reliable and consistently available during agreed working hours.

- A strong communicator with excellent written and spoken English.



Mandatory Requirements

* Proven professional bookkeeping experience.

* You must have a minimum of 5 years of professional Australian bookkeeping/accounting experience.

* Experience with Xero.

* Strong reconciliation, accounts payable and accounts receivable experience.

* Must have hands-on experience with Australian payroll, including setting up new employees and preparing/processing weekly payroll. 

* Must have a strong working knowledge of Australian bookkeeping and taxation requirements, including GST, BAS, PAYG and superannuation. 

* Must have hands-on experience processing and reconciling foreign currency invoices and payments.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.

* Experience investigating financial discrepancies.

* Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

* Reliable computer, internet connection, and professional work-from-home setup.

* Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet deadlines.

* Ability to work full-time during Melbourne business hours.

* Must be a Filipino citizen based in the Philippines.

* To confirm that you have read the full job description and understand the requirements of the role, please include the word “OFFROAD” in the subject line of your application.



Highly Advantageous

*Experience with any of the following will be highly regarded:

*Australian e-commerce or retail businesses

*Shopify

*Inventory management/accounting systems

*Freight or logistics reconciliation

*High-volume transaction environments

*Working directly with external Australian accountants



This position requires constant attention and ownership.



This Role May Not Be For You If...



If you prefer waiting for tasks to be assigned, checking
s only occasionally, leaving discrepancies for someone else to investigate, or needing regular reminders to follow up outstanding matters, this role will likely not be the right fit.

We need someone who sees something that doesn't look right and thinks:

“I need to check this.” and not: “Someone will tell me if there's a problem.”



Working Hours

Shift Hours – Full-Time Monday to Friday

Melbourne Time: (AEST/AEDT): 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

Philippine Time: (PHT): 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM (6:00 AM - 3:00 PM during AEDT)

Includes a 1-hour lunch break

Applicants must be able to consistently work Melbourne business hours.



TO APPLY

To be considered for this position:

You MUST submit an updated resume/CV.

You must have relevant professional bookkeeping experience.

You must have strong written and spoken English communication skills.

You must be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

You must be available during the stated Melbourne working hours.

You must be a Filipino citizen based in the Philippines.



Shortlisted applicants will be contacted directly regarding the next stage of the recruitment process.

title: Paint Our Kits at Home + Film Quiet ASMR iPhone Video (Paid Per Painting)
description:
Work from home. We ship the paint by numbers kits to you free. Paid per painting, not per hour.



We are a US paint-by-numbers wall art brand. We need one person to paint our kits at home and film the painting as quiet ASMR style video on an iPhone. No talking, no music, no face. Just hands, daylight, and the sound of the brush.



This is steady ongoing work, not a one-off. Start at 2 to 4 paintings a week. If the work is good we grow it and keep it running long term.



WHAT WE PAY FOR (one flat rate per painting covers all three)

1. The finished painting, neat, all numbers filled.

2. One edited vertical video, 15 to 60 seconds.

3. All the raw footage, delivered in full. We own all the footage.

You keep the finished painting.



REQUIREMENTS

- iPhone. Vertical 9:16. Sharp focus. No filters.

- Phone on a tripod or overhead stand, never handheld. Multiple Angles, showcasing progress on painting from start to finish. 

- Daylight only. Bright soft light from a window. No ring lights, no yellow bulbs, no night filming.

- Clean sound: brush on canvas, paint pots clicking open, stirring, brush rinsing. Quiet room, no talking, no music.

- Looks like a home, not a studio. Clean wooden or plain table. Minimal props.

- Women's hands only. Clean nails. No heavy jewelry.

- Four checkpoint shots every painting, same framing each time: start (blank canvas with paints laid out), halfway, three quarters, fully finished plus one reveal shot. Lots of broll of ASMR style content with the paint, brushes, close ups of brush painting on the canvas. 

- Continuous painting footage in between at close, medium, and wide angles.

- Deliver on Google Drive or Dropbox, one folder per painting, within 7 days of the kit arriving.



HOW TO APPLY

Reply with two things. Applications missing either one will be skipped.

1. Your rate per painting in USD, all three deliverables included.

2. A link to one 20 to 60 second clip of you painting anything by a window in daylight with clean audio. It does not have to be one of our kits.



We will pick 2 to 3 finalists and pay each for one trial painting before we choose.

title: Direct-Response Copywriter | VSLs & Affiliate Video Ads
description:
We're an affiliate marketing agency looking for a direct-response copywriter who can uncover fresh buying angles and turn audience research into persuasive video scripts. You'll work with media buyers and video editors to create, test and improve ads for nutra, telehealth, money/finance and other affiliate offers.



This is an ongoing, part-time role: US$600/month for 20 hours/week, plus performance commissions on winning creatives.



WHAT YOU'LL WRITE

- Video sales letters (VSLs), mini-VSLs and short-form direct-response affiliate video ads.

- Original hooks, buying angles, stories, proof sections, objection handling and calls to action.

- Clear creative briefs for editors, including opening visuals, scenes, on-screen text and pacing.



HOW YOU'LL WORK

- Research the audience, offer, competitors and customer language. Understand what people want, what they believe and what holds them back from buying.

- Use those insights to propose original angles and explain why each could resonate with the audience.

- Work with buyers to choose test priorities, review real campaign feedback and improve the next scripts.

- Keep scripts, briefs and revisions organized so editors and buyers can act on them.



WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Strong written English and relevant direct-response copywriting experience, especially video ads, VSLs or affiliate offers.

- Good audience insight, storytelling and persuasive structure.

- The ability to explain your creative decisions and take ownership from research through iteration.

- Reliable communication and availability for 20 hours per week.



Experience with nutra, telehealth or money/finance offers is helpful. AI tools can support your process; your own research, judgment and original creative thinking are essential.



Use accurate, supported health and financial claims and appropriate disclosures. Flag unsupported or restricted claims before production. No fabricated testimonials, results, medical claims or earnings promises.



PAY

- US$600 per month for 20 hours per week.

- Additional performance commissions on winning creatives. The definition of a winner, attribution, commission calculation and payment terms will be agreed before starting. Commissions depend on results and are not guaranteed.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with VSL600 as the first word, then send:

1. Links to 2–3 existing relevant scripts, VSLs, mini-VSLs or video ads. Briefly say what you personally wrote and label each as live campaign work or an untested concept.

2. For one sample, explain the audience insight and angle in a few sentences. Include results if available and permitted, with enough context to understand them; say whether you verified them yourself or they were reported by a client/team. It's fine if results aren't available.

3. Confirm that US$600/month for 20 hours/week works for you, your usual working hours/timezone and earliest start date.



Keep it short. Existing work is enough; no new unpaid sample is required to apply. Only share work you have permission to disclose and redact confidential details.

title: Catering & Partnerships Coordinator
description:

Our long-term goal is to build one of San Diego's leading dessert catering programs and create systems that can eventually support future locations and franchise growth.



Responsibilities

Qualifications



• Strong project management and organizational skills

• Excellent written and verbal English communication

• Strong customer service and relationship-building skills

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

• Experience in operations, project management, account management, customer success, hospitality, events, or sales preferred

• Strong attention to detail and follow-through

• Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

• Process-oriented and systems-minded

• Proactive problem solver



Success in this Role



• Leads receive responses within 24 hours

• Trello boards, SOPs, templates, and systems remain organized and current

• Leadership has visibility into the catering pipeline and performance

• The catering division becomes increasingly scalable and franchise-ready



We are seeking someone interested in a long-term role with significant ownership and growth opportunities. This is not a short-term, seasonal, or low-commitment position.

title: Guest Experience Specialist – Short-Term Rentals (Overnight, AI-Savvy)
description:
THIS IS NOT A SCRIPTED SUPPORT JOB.

RivetStays runs short-term rental homes for guests across North America (Airbnb, 
, VRBO, Expedia). Overnight in the Philippines, you're the person in charge. You'll handle guests, cleaners and maintenance in real time, with imperfect information and real consequences. We're hiring people who own the outcome, not people who read scripts and escalate.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

• Guest messages and calls, start to finish: check-in problems, complaints, requests, reviews

• Cleaners, maintenance and vendors when something breaks, in real time

• Refunds, credits and compensation decisions. You don't need permission for every dollar. Make the right call for the guest and the business, and own the result, good or bad. Your authority grows as your judgment proves itself.

• Keeping reservations, listings and our systems accurate (Beds24, Breezeway, PriceLabs, ClickUp, Missive, RingCentral)

• Back-office operations: expense and invoice tracking, discrepancy reporting, and bigger projects as you earn them

• Root causes: when something breaks twice, you fix the process, not just the ticket



HOW WE WORK

We use AI everywhere. You should already use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar every day (drafting replies, summarizing long threads, checking your work, automating repetitive tasks) and know when not to trust it.



YOU'RE A FIT IF

• You take in messy, complicated information and make a sound call fast, without freezing

• When something goes wrong on your watch, you fix it first and explain after. No excuses, no finger-pointing.

• You catch the detail everyone else missed

• You don't clock out on a broken situation. You finish it or hand it off clean.

• You care whether the guest actually had a great stay, not whether the ticket got closed



DON'T APPLY IF

• You need a script for everything

• You escalate every decision to a supervisor

• You want to clock in, answer messages and clock out



REQUIREMENTS

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Available for overnight shifts (PH time), including weekends and holidays

• Quiet workspace, 50 Mbps+ internet, your own reliable computer with a webcam

• Short-term rental or hospitality experience is a plus, not a requirement. Judgment and ownership matter more.



WHAT YOU GET

• Competitive hourly pay in USD, with raises for top performers

• Full-time hours, with extra paid hours whenever guests need them

• Real authority and a long-term role on a team that uses modern tools



HIRING PROCESS

Our process is harder than a typical support job, on purpose.

1. Online application and assessment (~70 min): your resume, a realistic shift simulation (AI tools allowed), an AI video interview, and two short tests

2. Interview with HR

3. Final interview

4. Two-week paid training



HOW TO APPLY

Apply here: 

We only review applications submitted through the link.

title: Shopify Web & Graphic Designer | E-commerce Creative Expert
description:
Dear Applicants,



Shopify Web & Graphic Designer – We're Hiring! 



We're looking for a Shopify Web Designer / Graphic Designer who can genuinely do the job well. One day you might be rebuilding a product page to convert better, the next designing the banners and creatives for a new launch. If you love turning ideas into a clean, on-brand storefront that sells, and you can show us work that proves it, this role is for you.



IMPORTANT: We value responsible, self-motivated people who take ownership of their work and can deliver quality work with minimal supervision.



Job Scope:

• Build, customise, and maintain pages on our Shopify store (landing pages, product pages, collection pages, and campaign pages)

• Customise the Shopify theme and work with page builder apps such as Shogun, GemPages, or PageFly to create clean, high-converting layouts

• Design storefront and marketing graphics: banners, hero images, product graphics, infographics, and promotional creatives

• Create on-brand visual assets for
 (EDMs), social media, and ad campaigns

• Ensure every page is mobile-responsive, fast-loading, and visually consistent with our brand guidelines

• Update and optimise pages and creatives for launches, promotions, and seasonal campaigns

• Work with the marketing and product teams to turn briefs into polished, on-brand designs

• Keep a consistent look and feel across the store and all marketing touchpoints



You should be comfortable with:

• Shopify theme customisation and at least one page builder app (Shogun, GemPages, PageFly, or similar)

• Core design tools such as Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva

• Building mobile-responsive, fast-loading pages

• A good eye for layout, typography, spacing, and brand consistency



Note:

• Full-time basis, 40 hrs/week

• Monday to Friday

• 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holidays Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines) included



IMPORTANT: When applying, please provide:

• Your CV/Resume

• A short video introduction of yourself and why you think you're a good fit

• Why you are leaving your last job or what you were doing just before this application

• A portfolio or examples of Shopify pages and graphic design work you have created previously.



Applications without the above points will be less considered.

My resume is here:

Video introduction here:

The more information you provide in your initial application, the better.

title: Shopify Specialist (Theme & Page Builder)
description:
Dear Applicants,



Shopify Specialist (Theme & Page Builder) – We're Hiring!



Our product team plans every page: the idea, which sections go where, and the copy. You bring it to life on our Shopify store as a clean, polished page that works beautifully on every screen. If you have years of Shopify experience, a sharp eye for detail, and enjoy using AI tools to work faster, this role is for you.



IMPORTANT: We value responsible, self-motivated people who take ownership of their work and can deliver quality work with minimal supervision.



Job Scope:

 • Build and update pages on our Shopify store (product, collection, landing and campaign pages) from briefs prepared by our product team

 • Customise our existing theme (sections, blocks and templates) and work with page builder apps such as GemPages, PageFly or Shogun

 • Make every page look polished and on-brand: consistent spacing, alignment, font sizes, colours and image quality

 • Create or adapt simple visuals (banners, section images) using AI tools and our in-house design guidelines, and judge whether the result looks right before using it

 • Use AI coding tools (such as Codex or Claude) to speed up builds, and check and test everything they produce before it goes live

 • Test every page before publishing: mobile layout, loading speed, links, and that it matches the brief

 • Flag layout or usability problems early and suggest simple fixes, for example content that will not work well on a phone

 • Update pages for launches, promotions and seasonal campaigns



You should have:

 • At least 4 years of hands-on Shopify experience building and improving store pages

 • Confidence editing Liquid and CSS within an existing theme (adjusting sections, adding settings, fixing layouts). You will customise our theme, not build themes or apps from scratch

 • Experience with at least one page builder app (GemPages, PageFly, Shogun or similar)

 • Evidence of improving a page's conversion or performance, with the before and after to show for it

 • A strong eye for visual detail: you notice when spacing is off, text is too small, images look stretched or a page feels cluttered

 • Good UI/UX awareness: you know what makes a page easy to use on a phone, and how to fix it when it is not

 • Comfort using AI tools to create visuals and write or edit code, and checking their output carefully



You do not need to be a graphic designer. Visuals can be created with AI tools using our design guidelines. What matters most is your eye for detail and your sense of what makes a page look good and sell well.



Note:

 • Full-time basis, 40 hrs/week

 • Monday to Friday

 • 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holidays Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines) included



IMPORTANT: When applying, please provide:

 • Your CV/Resume

 • A short video introduction of yourself and why you think you're a good fit

 • Why you are leaving your last job or what you were doing just before this application

 • Links to 2 to 3 Shopify pages you built or improved (live links preferred), with a short note on what you did for each. If you improved a page's conversion or speed, share the before and after



Applications without the above points will be less considered.



P.S. Please format your replies in point form according to the items asked above, e.g.:

 My resume is here:

 Video introduction here:

 I am currently doing... / I am leaving because...

 Here are links to Shopify pages I have built or improved...



The more information you provide in your initial application, the better.





Best regards,

 Loo Yi

title: Accountant - U.S. GAAP Experience
description:

About the Opportunity



We are seeking an experienced Remote Accountant to support the accounting and financial operations of multiple U.S.-based companies across several industries.



This opportunity is ideal for a hands-on accounting professional who is comfortable managing multiple responsibilities, working independently and supporting a growing organization with diverse accounting needs.



Direct experience performing accounting work under U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (U.S. GAAP) for U.S.-based companies is a mandatory requirement.



We are looking for someone with practical accounting experience who can contribute beyond routine bookkeeping and take ownership of accounting responsibilities with accuracy, sound judgment and consistent follow-through.



Key Responsibilities



Prepare and post journal entries, accruals and adjusting entries.



Perform bank, credit card, general ledger and balance-sheet reconciliations.



Support monthly, quarterly and year-end closing activities.



Prepare financial statements, supporting schedules and management reports.



Maintain accurate general ledger records across multiple business entities.



Investigate discrepancies, research accounting issues and resolve errors.



Support accounts payable, accounts receivable and intercompany accounting.



Assist with budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis and cash-flow reporting.



Coordinate audit documentation and support financial compliance requirements.



Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, reporting and efficiency.



Collaborate with U.S.-based Finance leadership and operational teams.



Required Qualifications



Applicants must meet all of the following qualifications:



Minimum 3 years of direct, hands-on accounting experience applying U.S. GAAP for U.S.-based companies.



At least 3-5 years of professional accounting experience with meaningful responsibility for general ledger accounting and financial reporting.



Demonstrated experience with journal entries, accruals, reconciliations and monthly or quarterly closing processes.



Experience preparing or substantially contributing to financial statements.



Ability to independently investigate accounting discrepancies and resolve problems.



Proficiency with accounting software or ERP systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Xero or comparable platforms.



Strong Microsoft Excel skills and attention to detail.



Strong written and spoken English communication skills.



Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines and work independently with minimal supervision.



Important: General bookkeeping, AP/AR processing, external audit experience or employment with an international organization does not independently satisfy the required hands-on U.S. GAAP accounting experience.



Preferred Qualifications



Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.



CPA certification or equivalent professional accounting credential (not required).



Experience supporting multiple U.S. business entities or companies across different industries.



Experience with intercompany accounting, consolidations and multi-entity financial reporting.



Experience with financial dashboards, Power BI, financial analysis or FP&A support.



Familiarity with AI tools, accounting automation and process improvements.



Experience working directly with U.S.-based accounting or finance leadership.



Work Schedule & Contractor Expectations



Remote independent contractor engagement.



Work hours generally fall within 8:00 AM-8:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday-Friday.



Expected workload of approximately 50-60 hours per week, depending on business needs.



Must have a reliable personal computer and high-speed internet connection.

Backup internet and power arrangements are required.



Must have a private, secure workspace suitable for handling confidential financial information.



Must be comfortable working independently and communicating regularly with U.S.-based teams.

Compensation will be based on relevant experience, demonstrated accounting capabilities and the contractor's proposed monthly rate.



Applicants must provide an all-inclusive monthly contractor bid in USD, based on an anticipated workload of 50-60 hours per week.



This is an independent contractor opportunity without employee benefits. Payments are made monthly on net-30 terms through an approved payment method.



We are interested in developing an ongoing contractor relationship, with an initial engagement of up to one year and potential renewal based on business needs, performance and overall fit.



How to Apply



Please
 
 with the subject:



Remote Accountant Application

A brief overview of your relevant accounting experience.



The U.S.-based companies or clients you have supported and the approximate dates of those engagements.



Your proposed monthly contractor bid in USD, based on the expected workload of 50-60 hours per week.

Important Application Requirements

Relevant experience with general ledger accounting, financial reporting and monthly or quarterly close.



Substantive accounting responsibilities beyond basic bookkeeping, AP/AR processing or external audit.

**Full-Time | Remote | US Hours | Healthcare / Mental Health**



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced  Patient Services Team Lead / Trainer to lead, coach, train, and support a small team of approximately 5–10 Patient Representatives.



Our Patient Representatives are the first point of contact for patients, handling inbound calls, answering inquiries, providing information about our services, scheduling appointments, and ensuring a professional and positive patient experience.



This is a hands-on leadership role. In addition to managing and training the team, the Team Lead / Trainer will also take inbound calls when team members are on break, unavailable, or when call volume is high and there is a queue of waiting patients.



What You'll Do



* Manage and support a team of 5–10 Patient Representatives

* Train new and existing representatives on inbound call handling, phone etiquette, patient communication, and company procedures

* Train representatives to properly answer patient inquiries and explain our services

* Train and coach the team on appointment scheduling, rescheduling, follow-ups, and handling patient concerns

* Review calls and conduct QA evaluations to ensure quality and adherence to standards

* Provide regular coaching and actionable feedback to improve performance

* Monitor team KPIs, including call quality, productivity, appointment setting, and conversion

* Coach representatives on objection handling and appropriate sales/conversion techniques

* Handle inbound patient calls when team members are on break, out of office, or when call volume is high and there are multiple calls waiting in the queue

* Assist with escalated or difficult patient interactions

* Identify performance gaps and provide additional training when needed

* Help create and improve training materials, scripts, SOPs, and call flows

* Report team performance and areas for improvement to management

* Ensure representatives maintain professionalism and patient confidentiality



What We're Looking For



* 2+ years of call center experience

* Previous experience as a Team Lead, Trainer, QA Analyst, Supervisor, or similar role

* Strong training and coaching experience

* Hands-on QA / call monitoring experience

* Experience training customer service, receptionist, or patient service representatives

* Excellent English communication and phone skills

* Strong leadership and people-management skills

* Comfortable taking calls and working alongside the team when needed

* Understanding of call center KPIs and quality standards

* Comfortable working with CRM, scheduling, QA, and communication systems

* Able to work independently in a remote environment

* Willing and able to work US hours



Preferred Qualifications



*Sales or telesales experience

* Appointment-setting or lead-conversion experience

* Healthcare, medical, mental health, or telehealth experience

* Experience managing a team of 5–10+ representatives

* Experience creating training programs, scripts, SOPs, or QA scorecards

* Experience managing remote call center teams



How to Apply

Please submit your resume and cover letter explaining your relevant call center, QA, training, and team leadership experience.



IMPORTANT: Please use `ROCKSTART TRAINER` as the subject of your cover letter.



**Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be reviewed.**

title: Surplus Recovery Case Coordinator
description:
Surploom is a young company that helps people pursue surplus funds after tax sales and mortgage foreclosures. We’ve also just launched **SurploomOS**, our software for surplus recovery work.



We’re looking for a reliable, organized person to help coordinate individual surplus recovery cases when needed. This is **not a part-time or full-time position**. Work is assigned case by case, so there are no guaranteed cases, hours, or monthly earnings. We currently have two interested claimants who may need help.



## What you’ll do



For each case assigned to you, you may:



- Review the lead details, including the sale type, county, property address, case number, sale date, claimant, and available records.

- Research the applicable state, county, and court procedures. Contact the appropriate county office, court, trustee, or sale office to confirm whether funds are being held and ask what claim process, documents, and deadlines apply.

- Follow **all applicable state and county rules and procedures for that case**. Requirements vary by state, county, and sale type, so the steps may differ or be more extensive from one case to another. Following the applicable rules is mandatory, with no exceptions. If you cannot confirm what the rules require, pause and ask Surploom before proceeding.

- Keep clear records of the instructions you receive, sources checked, deadlines, and follow-up needed.

- Speak with claimants by phone, explain updates clearly and respectfully, and help them gather and organize documents requested by the relevant office.

- Coordinate administrative forms or submissions when appropriate.

- Follow up with the relevant office, track the case, and keep the claimant informed until the funds are paid or the case reaches another outcome.

- If a case may need legal help, contact an appropriate specialized attorney from Surploom’s approved network and coordinate the referral and next steps with the claimant.



**The steps listed above are examples, not a complete checklist for every case.** Some cases may require additional steps, documents, research, follow-up, or coordination depending on the state, county, sale type, and claimant’s circumstances. You are expected to identify and complete the steps required for each specific case while following Surploom’s instructions and applicable rules.



## Requirements



- Be available for calls and follow-up during agreed **U.S. business hours**. The schedule will depend on the claimant, county, and case needs.

- Be comfortable making and receiving phone calls with U.S. claimants and government or court offices.

- Speak English clearly and be easy to understand over the phone. **A perfect American accent is not required.**

- Communicate professionally, patiently, and respectfully, including when discussing sensitive situations such as a former home, financial hardship, or a deceased family member.

- Be organized, dependable, careful with confidential information, and consistent about documenting calls, deadlines, and next steps.

- Be willing to research unfamiliar state and county procedures and ask for guidance whenever a requirement is unclear.



This role does not require a law degree or legal license. It does require careful research and strict compliance with the rules that apply to each case. You must not provide legal advice, d
 who is legally entitled to funds, or perform legal work.



## Compensation and estimated workload



The proposed pay is **$120 per assigned claimant case**, paid in stages as work is completed:



- **$40** after the initial case review and confirmation of the process and funds holder.

- **$40** after the claimant’s requested documents are organized and any appropriate administrative submission or handoff is completed.

- **$40** after the case’s final status is confirmed and the case record is updated.



Payment is for the coordination work and does not depend on whether the claimant ultimately receives funds. If a case requires substantially more steps or work than expected, any additional payment must be discussed and agreed upon before that extra work begins. Attorney fees and other case expenses are separate.



The workload may average **up to approximately 10 hours per week when cases are assigned**, but hours can vary from week to week. There is no guarantee of 10 hours each week or of ongoing work.



**Earnings examples:**



- **1 case completed in a month:** $150

- **2 cases completed in a month:** $300

- **4 cases completed in a month:** $600

- **8 cases completed in a month:** $1,200



These are examples only. Actual earnings depend on how many cases Surploom assigns and the work required for each case. Some cases may take longer or require additional steps, and case work may continue over multiple weeks or months.



## Potential future opportunities



As Surploom grows, this work could potentially develop into a larger or full-time role, but **there is no guarantee**. Surploom is a young company, and we launched SurploomOS today.



If SurploomOS gains clients who need help coordinating their own surplus cases, there may also be opportunities to support those clients for additional pay. Any such work and compensation would be discussed and agreed upon in advance; it is not guaranteed.



## To apply



Please send a short introduction describing your experience with case coordination, document preparation, customer communication, or researching and contacting government or court offices. Include your availability during U.S. business hours, your experience handling phone calls.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Here is a professional, conversion-optimized job description tailored to your software stack and platforms. To respect your preference for keeping operational metrics private from competitors, this draft highlights the technical requirements and scale without disclosing specific order volumes or revenue figures.



Job Title: E-commerce Bookkeeper / Virtual Assistant (Amazon, Walmart, Temu)

Location: Remote

Job Type: Part-Time / Full-Time



 Job Summary

We are a growing, fast-paced multi-channel e-commerce business selling across major marketplaces, including Amazon, Walmart, and Temu. We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and experienced E-commerce Bookkeeper / Virtual Assistant to manage our daily financial tracking, reconciliation, and inventory reporting.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience handling the unique financial structures of Amazon accounts and must be proficient with e-commerce accounting workflows. Experience with our exact tech stack—specifically Connectbooks and Nineyard—is a significant advantage.



 Key Responsibilities



* Marketplace Reconciliation: Reconcile multi-channel payouts (Amazon settlements, Walmart payments, Temu disbursements) against actual sales, returns, operational fees, and reserves.

* Software Management: Utilize Connectbooks to automate and sync financial data, ensuring clean, accurate transaction tracking down to the item level.

* Inventory & Cost of Goods Sold (COGS): Work alongside our master inventory system (Nineyard) to track inventory value, monitor accounts payable for suppliers, and accurately calculate monthly COGS.

* Financial Reporting: Maintain up-to-date Profit & Loss (P&L) statements, balance sheets, and cash flow tracking.

* Discrepancy Investigation: Identify, audit, and resolve any settlement discrepancies, fee overcharges, or inventory discrepancies from marketplaces.



 Qualifications & Requirements



* Experience: Minimum 2+ years of bookkeeping experience specifically for Amazon sellers (FBA and FBM models). Experience with multi-marketplace environments (Walmart, Temu) is highly preferred.

* Tech Stack: Strong proficiency with Connectbooks is a major plus. Experience working with multi-channel inventory software like Nineyard is highly desirable. Proficient in standard accounting software (QuickBooks Online or Xero).

* E-commerce Knowledge: Deep understanding of Amazon-specific financial concepts, including delayed deposits, A-to-z claim impacts, reserve balances, and automated fee structures.

* Analytical Skills: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills with a sharp eye for numbers and data integrity.

* Communication: Strong English communication skills and the ability to work independently in a remote setting.



What We Offer



* Competitive compensation based on experience.

* Flexible remote working hours.

* Opportunity for long-term growth as the business expands.



Note: Even if you do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we still encourage you to apply! Please let us know exactly which area or software you are missing in your application, and we can discuss providing a ramp-up period to fill in the gap over your first few weeks.

title: Construction Compliance Specialist | Licensing, Insurance & Certified Payroll
description:
We are looking for an experienced Construction Compliance Specialist to manage contractor licensing, insurance compliance, certified payroll, prevailing wage requirements, GC prequalification, and regulatory registrations for our growing U.S. construction operation.



This role sits at the center of our operations and is responsible for making sure our company and projects remain licensed, insured, compliant, and ready to operate, bid, mobilize, and get paid.



The ideal candidate has experience supporting U.S. construction companies, contractors, subcontractors, or general contractors and is highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple deadlines across states, projects, and compliance requirements.



Key Responsibilities



Licensing & Business Registration



Maintain contractor licenses and business registrations across all states where we operate.



Track license and registration renewal deadlines and state filing calendars.



Proactively coordinate renewals before expiration.



Maintain the company's status on approved subcontractor/vendor lists with general contractors.



Keep compliance records and documentation organized and up to date.



Insurance, Bonding & COI Management



Maintain Certificates of Insurance (COIs) according to the specific requirements of general contractors and project owners.



Track insurance expiration dates and required coverage.



Manage state-specific workers' compensation requirements, including states that require direct accounts.



Coordinate bonding requirements for government and commercial contracts.



Assemble complete compliance packages prior to project mobilization.



Follow up with insurance providers, brokers, and internal teams to resolve documentation issues.



Prevailing Wage & Certified Payroll



Determine whether projects are subject to Davis-Bacon, state prevailing wage laws, or both.



Research and obtain the appropriate wage determinations.



Manage California public works compliance, including DIR registration, DAS filings, and eCPR submissions.



Prepare and submit certified payroll reports accurately and on schedule.



Respond to agency inquiries related to certified payroll and prevailing wage requirements.



Notify the accounting/payroll team in writing of wage rates, classifications, and reporting schedules before payroll runs.



Maintain organized records of wage determinations, classifications, and payroll compliance documentation.



Federal Contracting



Maintain 
 registration and keep CAGE, UEI, and related identifiers current.



Maintain agency-specific portal registrations required for federal contracting.



Monitor registration requirements and renewal deadlines.



GC Prequalification & Vendor Portals



Complete and maintain general contractor prequalification applications.



Set up and maintain company accounts across compliance and payment platforms such as:



ISNetworld



Avetta



Textura



Procore



LCPTracker



Upload and maintain required company, insurance, safety, financial, and compliance documentation.



Maintain a detailed prequalification and compliance status log.



Identify upcoming expirations, missing documentation, or compliance lapses before they affect bidding, mobilization, or payment.



Payment Compliance & Project Closeout



Confirm compliance and certified payroll status before pay applications are submitted.



Coordinate with accounting and project management to resolve compliance issues that could delay billing.



Support project closeout requirements.



Assist with lien waivers, retention release documentation, and other payment compliance requirements.



Maintain accurate records throughout the project lifecycle.



Qualifications



Required



Experience in construction compliance, contractor/subcontractor administration, construction operations, contract administration, or a related field.



Experience supporting U.S. construction companies, contractors, subcontractors, or general contractors is strongly preferred.



Strong understanding of compliance documentation, deadlines, and administrative processes.



Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.



Ability to manage multiple deadlines across different states, projects, and entities without dropping requirements.



Strong written and verbal English communication skills.



Ability to independently track issues, follow up with stakeholders, and proactively prevent compliance lapses.



Proficiency with Google Drive and Microsoft Office.



Comfortable learning and working across multiple online platforms and databases.



Preferred Experience



Experience with one or more of the following is highly valued:



Contractor licensing and state registrations



General contractor prequalification



Insurance compliance and Certificates of Insurance (COIs)



Workers' compensation requirements



Prevailing wage compliance



Davis-Bacon requirements



Certified payroll



California DIR



California DAS



California eCPR







CAGE / UEI



ISNetworld



Avetta



Textura



Procore



LCPTracker



Salesforce



Airtable



California public works and certified payroll experience is a strong advantage.



The Ideal Candidate



You are highly organized, proactive, and comfortable being the person responsible for making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



You naturally think:



"What expires next, what is missing, and what could prevent this project from moving forward?"



You don't wait until a license expires, a GC rejects a COI, or certified payroll is due to discover a problem.



You proactively monitor deadlines, maintain accurate records, communicate with stakeholders, and make sure requirements are completed before they become an issue.



You should also be comfortable communicating with:



General contractors



Project managers



Accounting and payroll teams



Insurance brokers



Government agencies



Vendors and subcontractors



Internal leadership



Because this position touches licensing, insurance, payroll, contracts, billing, and project operations, strong attention to detail and ownership are essential.



Why Join Us?



This role sits at the center of the business and provides direct visibility into how a national contracting operation runs.



As the company continues to grow, there is room to expand your responsibilities into broader areas such as:



Construction compliance



Risk management



Contract administration



Vendor management



Regulatory compliance



Construction operations



If you have experience in construction compliance, contractor administration, certified payroll, prevailing wage, licensing, insurance compliance, or GC prequalification, we'd love to hear from you.



Screening Questions



1. Construction Compliance Experience



How many years of experience do you have working in construction compliance, contractor/subcontractor administration, construction operations, or a related role supporting U.S. clients? Please briefly describe your experience and responsibilities.



2. Compliance Systems & Regulations



Which of the following have you personally worked with? Select all that apply and briefly explain your experience: Contractor Licensing, COI/Insurance Compliance, Prevailing Wage, Davis-Bacon, Certified Payroll, California DIR/DAS/eCPR, 
, ISNetworld, Avetta, Procore, Textura, or LCPTracker.



3. Compliance Scenario



A contractor license, insurance certificate, or GC prequalification is about to expire, and a project is scheduled to mobilize soon. What steps would you take to make sure the project is not delayed?



Please provide a specific example if you have handled a similar situation before.

title: Full-Stack AI Engineer / Web Developer (AI-Assisted Coding)
description:

We run lean on purpose: a handful of people, heavy use of AI, and systems that do the work of a much larger company. We're looking for one strong builder to turn detailed specs into working products, using AI coding tools to move fast without cutting corners.







You'll work directly with the founder, who is based in Bali on the same timezone as the Philippines.







What you'll build







A custom app for HighLevel (GoHighLevel), the CRM our contractors use.



Built with OAuth, custom pages, custom workflow triggers and actions, custom objects and webhooks.



It connects contractors' CRM accounts to our own platform.



It adds a branded inspection report generator, an estimator and proposal builder, and job costing.



A HighLevel template that sets up contractor accounts: pipelines, custom fields, forms, calendars, workflows and message templates.



Our core web platform. A property and job record system with:



a mobile-first, offline-capable field app for technicians (photos, readings, checklists)



warranty registration and a review queue



dealer ordering and a certification portal



an internal admin dashboard



Lead-generation tools. An instant roof and basement estimator widget, data-driven property lists, and integrations with mapping and property-data APIs.







Detailed specs are already written. Your job is to build them well, ask good questions, and tell us when something in a spec won't work.







Our stack







TypeScript, React, Node.js



tRPC, Drizzle ORM, MySQL or Postgres



HighLevel API and Marketplace modules



REST APIs and webhooks



Cloudflare, Vercel or similar hosting



AI coding tools daily: Claude Code, Cursor or similar







You must have







3+ years building and shipping full-stack web apps in TypeScript and React, with live projects you can show us.



Daily, serious use of AI coding tools. You know how to direct them, review their output, catch their mistakes, and keep a codebase clean when AI writes most of the first draft.



Experience integrating third-party APIs: OAuth, webhooks, and working from documentation you've never seen before. HighLevel experience isn't required; we'll expect you to learn its developer platform quickly with the help of AI tools.



Solid backend fundamentals: auth and permissions, database design, API security, and never trusting client input.



Comfort with ownership. You test your own work, write clear updates, and finish things.



Good written English. Most of our communication is async and written.







Nice to have







HighLevel (GoHighLevel) experience: snapshots, workflows, the API, or a Marketplace app



Offline-first mobile web apps (PWA, background sync)



Maps and geospatial work (Mapbox or Google Maps, parcel or building-footprint data)



PDF report generation



Stripe or payment integrations



Experience with construction, field-service or contractor software







How we work







Full time, async-first, with a short daily check-in during PH business hours.



Paid tools: AI coding subscriptions and hosting accounts are covered.



Real responsibility from week one. You won't be maintaining someone else's ticket queue.



Everything you build is owned by the company, and you'll sign an NDA and IP assignment.







How to apply







Send a message with:







Links to 2â3 things you've built, and your role in each.



A time you had to learn an unfamiliar API or platform quickly. How long did it take to ship something working, and how did you use AI tools to get there?



A short description of how you use AI coding tools day to day, and one time an AI tool gave you wrong code and how you caught it.



An intro video (2-3 minutes) introducing yourself. Walk us through your background and the projects you have built, then share a link (Loom, Google Drive, YouTube, etc.). Make sure the link is viewable without a password or sign-in.



Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

title: FEMALE Performance Video Editor — Paid Social

Who we are

Our hero product, the Stay Close Hoop, is a backless hoop designed for comfortable, uninterrupted wear. We've served 175,000+ customers across the US, UK, Australia, Canada and Europe, backed by 7,000+ five-star reviews.



We're looking for a female video editor with exceptional taste in content made for women to join our creative team.



The role

- You'll work alongside a Creative Strategist to turn briefs into high-performing Meta and TikTok ads.

- This role sits at the intersection of aesthetic taste and performance creative.

- You need to understand the visual world our female customer lives in — jewelry, beauty, fashion, lifestyle, GRWM and creator content — while also knowing how to make an ad hook, hold attention and convert.

- We're not looking for cinematic brand films.

- We're looking for beautiful ads that sell.



What you'll do



Edit paid social ads at volume.

Turn structured creative briefs into compelling short-form ads using creator/UGC footage, product footage, testimonials, photography and other assets.



Make jewelry desirable.

Have a strong eye for product close-ups, ear stacks, styling, composition, typography, music and shot selection. You should instinctively know which shot makes someone think: I want those earrings.



Create content native to women's feeds.

Your work should feel at home alongside the jewelry, beauty, fashion and lifestyle content women already consume on TikTok and Instagram — not like a traditional advertisement dropped into their feed.



Build variants of winners.

Create new hooks, openings, pacing, overlays, product reveals, testimonials and CTAs around proven concepts so we can systematically find what improves performance.



Turn raw UGC into great ads.

Find the strongest hooks, reactions, product moments and soundbites from creator footage and restructure them into ads that feel natural while still selling.



Use AI where useful.

AI isn't the focus of the role, but you should be comfortable using modern image/video and voice tools when they can efficiently fill a footage gap or improve an edit.



Learn from performance.

You'll see how your ads perform and should understand metrics like hook rate, hold rate, CTR and CPA well enough to form a point of view on what worked and what to test next.



What we're looking for

- Exceptional female-focused aesthetic taste. Your portfolio must demonstrate strong TikTok or Instagram content created for female audiences. Jewelry, beauty, fashion and lifestyle experience is highly relevant.

- Paid social experience. You've edited performance ads for a D2C/e-commerce brand or performance agency and understand that creative ultimately gets judged by results.

- Strong short-form instincts. You understand hooks, retention, pacing, mobile-first typography, product reveals, UGC storytelling and direct-response structure.

- Speed. You can produce and iterate quickly without becoming sloppy. You know which details affect performance and which don't.

- Ownership. You don't blindly execute briefs. If a hook isn't working visually or the footage isn't supporting the concept, you flag it and propose a solution

- Organization. You're comfortable managing multiple concepts and variants with clean naming, version control and ClickUp handoffs.



We're tool-agnostic — Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci, CapCut or similar are all fine.



Nice to have: jewelry/beauty/fashion experience, motion graphics, TikTok Spark Ads, AI-assisted production and localization experience.



Who you'll work with

- You'll work inside an ARDANT creative pod, led by a Creative Strategist and potentially alongside other Video Editors.

The strategist owns the audience, angle and persuasion strategy.

- You own making it visually compelling enough to stop someone and clear enough to sell.



Who this isn't for

- This isn't the right role if your strongest work is long-form brand films, you don't regularly consume female-focused TikTok/Instagram content, you need weeks to finish an asset, or you dislike creating multiple iterations of the same concept.



At ARDANT, creative gets tested quickly.



We care less about defending an edit and more about finding the edit that wins.



Logistics

Engagement: Independent contractor

Location: Fully remote

Timezone: Meaningful GMT+8 overlap required

Compensation: Monthly fee + performance bonus

Tools: Required software/AI credits covered by ARDANT



How to apply

Keep it simple. Send us:



1. Your portfolio

Show us your best TikTok/Instagram work, especially content created for female audiences in jewelry, beauty, fashion or lifestyle.



2. Your best 3 paid social ads

For each, tell us in one or two sentences what you edited and, if available, how it performed.



3. One sentence:

What's one thing most video editors get wrong when creating ads for women?



That's it.



Paid test

Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid ARDANT editing test using a real brief, raw creator footage and product assets.



We'll evaluate:



Aesthetic Taste · Hook Execution · Product Presentation · Pacing · Performance Thinking · Speed



We're not looking for the fanciest editor.



We're looking for someone who can consistently turn an ARDANT brief into an ad women want to watch and buy from.

title: Trainee Support & Enrollment Specialist
description:
Company: HITCON Philippines Technical Solutions Corporation Location: Remote / Hybrid (Philippines) Employment Type: Full-time Department: Training & Candidate Services



About Us



HITCON Philippines Technical Solutions Corporation is a Philippine company with Austrian leadership, specializing in technical training and skilled worker deployment. Through our Welding Division (partnered with CTCweld) and Meat Processing Division (partnered with Infinity Vocational Technical School Inc.), we prepare Filipino professionals for deployment to European industry partners — with training across multiple sites in the Philippines and language training through our partner Speexx.



Role Overview



We are looking for a dedicated, people-oriented Trainee Support & Enrollment Specialist to join our team. This is a multi-faceted role — part customer service, part teaching assistant, part virtual assistant — all centered around one goal: keeping our trainees supported, committed, and on track from first inquiry through to deployment.



You will be the primary point of contact for aspiring trainees: explaining our programs, guiding them through enrollment, coordinating placements across training locations, and staying in touch with them throughout their training journey. You'll also assist instructors during sessions and handle general administrative tasks that keep the training operations running smoothly.



Key Responsibilities



Trainee Recruitment & Onboarding



Respond to inquiries from prospective trainees (phone, chat, email, social media)

Explain training programs clearly: welding (ISO 9606), meat processing, and other programs as they launch

Walk candidates through eligibility requirements, training schedules, costs, and career pathways

Enroll trainees into the appropriate training locations based on availability, region, and program

Coordinate language training enrollment (Speexx — German A2 and other languages) where applicable

Maintain accurate trainee records in the Hitcon Candidate Tracker system

Trainee Retention & Long-Term Support



Build relationships with trainees to keep them motivated and committed throughout the full training cycle

Conduct regular check-ins (weekly/bi-weekly) with active trainees to monitor progress and address concerns

Identify at-risk trainees early and coordinate support or intervention

Help trainees navigate challenges — scheduling conflicts, financial concerns, personal issues affecting attendance

Keep trainees engaged between training phases and during waiting periods (e.g., visa processing, deployment preparation)

Serve as the trainee's advocate within Hitcon — relaying feedback to instructors and leadership

Teaching Assistant Duties



Assist instructors during training sessions as needed (preparation, setup, logistics)

Help manage training materials, equipment lists, and classroom/facility readiness

Monitor attendance and participation, follow up on absences

Support practical assessment coordination and documentation

Step in to help with trainee questions outside of formal instruction time

Customer Service Representative



Handle trainee and partner inquiries professionally and promptly

Manage the training inbox and communication channels

Resolve scheduling conflicts, enrollment issues, and general complaints

Maintain a positive, supportive tone in all trainee communications

Liaise with training partners (Infinity VT School, CTCweld, Speexx) on enrollment and logistics

General Virtual Assistant Tasks



Data entry and record management in the Hitcon Candidate Tracker

Prepare training certificates, enrollment confirmations, and completion documents

Organize and maintain digital trainee files and documents

Schedule and coordinate training sessions across multiple locations

Assist leadership with reporting, trainee summaries, and operational updates

Support other Hitcon team members with administrative tasks as needed

Qualifications



Bachelor's degree (any field) or equivalent experience

1–2 years of experience in customer service, training coordination, teaching assistance, or virtual assistant roles

Excellent Filipino and English communication skills (written and spoken)

Strong interpersonal skills — patient, empathetic, and genuinely enjoys helping people

Comfortable using digital tools: Google Workspace, messaging apps, CRM/database systems

Organized and detail-oriented with good time management

Willing to learn Hitcon's training programs in detail to explain them accurately

Preferred Qualifications



Experience in vocational training, education, or recruitment support

Familiarity with TESDA programs, training certification processes, or skilled trades

Background in teaching, tutoring, or coaching

Experience working with multiple training sites or coordinating across locations

Basic knowledge of European deployment processes (visa, work permit, language requirements)

Personal Qualities We're Looking For



People person — you genuinely care about others' success and can build trust naturally

Patient and persistent — trainees come from diverse backgrounds and need steady, consistent support

Adaptable — you'll wear multiple hats in a single day and shift between them smoothly

Proactive — you don't wait for problems to escalate; you check in before things go wrong

What We Offer



Competitive salary commensurate with experience

Flexible working arrangement (remote/hybrid)

Meaningful role — you directly help Filipinos build careers abroad

Direct collaboration with Austrian leadership and training partners

Professional growth as Hitcon's training programs expand

Opportunity to grow into a training operations or program management role
