title: Operations & Marketing Coordinator
description:
OPERATIONS & MARKETING COORDINATOR



Part-Time | Approximately 20 Hours/Week | $700–$800 USD/Month, Based on Experience | Long-Term | Remote



Hi! I’m Charesse, founder of Level Best, an operations consulting firm serving financial advisory firms, and creator of FinOps Co-op® (FOCO), an online community and resource hub for financial operations professionals.



I currently run the business independently, and I’m ready to bring on someone who can take meaningful ownership of the recurring work that keeps the business moving.



I do my best work when I can focus on vision, relationships, business development, and creating great work for our audience and clients. I’m looking for someone who does their best work on the other side of that equation — bringing organization to moving pieces, turning ideas into action, and making sure the details and follow-through happen.



This role requires someone who can work independently and take ownership while communicating well. We’ll primarily collaborate asynchronously using tools like ClickUp and Loom, with a weekly meeting to align on priorities, questions, and what’s ahead.



This is a long-term role, and I’m looking for someone who wants to grow with the business.



Responsibilities generally fall into four areas. Percentages are approximate and may shift over time.





WHAT YOU’LL OWN



FOCO OPERATIONS & ONLINE COMMUNITY — APPROX. 40%



FOCO is an online membership community with virtual programming, resources, and events.



• Coordinate virtual speakers, including scheduling, collecting materials, reminders, and follow-up

• Support webinars, open sessions, and other online programming from planning through follow-up

• Post session replays and supporting resources

• Support new member onboarding and routine member requests

• Maintain our online Training & Templates Library

• Keep programming calendars, deadlines, and recurring responsibilities organized



Attendance at live FOCO events is not required.





MARKETING EXECUTION — APPROX. 35%



• Build and prepare
 newsletters

• Create and update graphics in Canva

• Turn webinars and other long-form content into short promotional clips

• Repurpose existing content for social and other marketing

• Prepare speaker, event, and partner promotional materials

• Prepare and schedule LinkedIn content

• Upload and organize YouTube content

• Make routine website and content updates





SALES & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT SUPPORT — APPROX. 15%



I’ll continue to lead sales conversations, relationship building, and closing business. You’ll help make sure the process around those activities stays organized.



• Maintain lead and opportunity information

• Keep the sales pipeline organized and current

• Track leads generated through speaking engagements, webinars, referrals, and marketing

• Coordinate follow-up, scheduling, and sales materials

• Flag opportunities and next steps that need my attention



This is not a cold-calling or sales-closing role.





LEVEL BEST OPERATIONS & PROCESS SUPPORT — APPROX. 10%



• Support special projects, research, and general business operations

• Maintain and update existing SOPs and checklists as processes evolve

• Help establish recurring weekly, monthly, quarterly, and event-driven routines as you learn the role

• Keep shared resources and documentation organized

• Identify opportunities to make recurring work simpler or more efficient





WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR



• At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in operations, marketing coordination, project coordination, online community management, executive support, or a similar role

• Highly organized with experience owning recurring responsibilities, managing deadlines, and coordinating multiple moving pieces

• Clear and professional written and spoken English

• Takes initiative, follows through, and is comfortable figuring things out without needing step-by-step direction

• Tech-savvy, resourceful, and comfortable using AI and learning new systems

• Good judgment about when to move something forward independently and when to ask for input



Financial services experience is not required. I care more about your ability to learn, organize, communicate, execute, and take ownership.





TECHNOLOGY



Our current technology stack includes:



Circle, Canva, Descript, Mailchimp, WordPress, YouTube, LinkedIn, Google Workspace, Zoom, ThriveCart, ClickUp, Zapier, CRM/sales tools, Loom, and AI tools.



You do not need experience with every platform.



You should have strong hands-on experience with Canva and Google Workspace, along with experience across several areas such as
 marketing, social/content publishing, video editing, project management, online community platforms, CRM, or website management.



Experience with Mailchimp, Descript, Circle, ClickUp, WordPress, or similar platforms is especially helpful. Familiarity with Zapier or other automation tools is a plus, but not required.



You should also be comfortable using AI tools in your work and learning unfamiliar technology independently.





SCHEDULE & ROLE DETAILS



• 20 hours per week

• $700–$800 USD/month, based on experience

• Long-term opportunity

• 100% remote

• Majority of work can be completed asynchronously during your preferred working hours

• Must be available for one recurring weekly meeting on Tuesdays between 8:00 AM and 3:00 PM U.S. Central Time; we’ll select the specific time together

• Attendance at live FOCO events is not required

• External
s, posts, and other communications should be scheduled for appropriate U.S. business hours when needed

• Opportunity for increased responsibilities and hours as the role and business grow



You must have reliable internet, your own reliable computer, and a private work environment appropriate for handling confidential business information.





HOW TO APPLY



I’d love to learn a little about you beyond your resume.



IMPORTANT: Please include the word “PINEAPPLE” in the subject line of your application.



Please also include:



1. Your resume

2. A brief introduction sharing why this particular opportunity interests you

3. A 1–2 minute video introducing yourself and sharing why you believe you’d be a great fit for the role. No professional editing or production is necessary — I simply want an opportunity to learn a little more about you.

4. Examples of relevant work, if available. This could include newsletters, Canva designs, social content, video clips, project plans, online community work, or other work you’re proud of.

5. Your current availability and potential start date

6. Your availability on Tuesdays between 8:00 AM and 3:00 PM U.S. Central Time



At the end of your application, please answer:



Which responsibility in this job description would you feel most confident taking ownership of, and why?





WHAT TO EXPECT



Selected candidates will be invited to a short video interview.



A small number of finalists will then complete a paid work exercise based on the type of work you would actually do in this role.



Before an offer is finalized, selected finalists will be asked to provide professional references and consent to a background check.



I’m looking for someone who wants to become a trusted, long-term part of Level Best and FOCO. If you enjoy bringing organization to moving pieces, turning ideas into action, and taking pride in following through, I’d love to hear from you.

title: Payroll and Accounting Assistant
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Insurance Payroll & Accounting Specialist to join our team full-time. This role is responsible for managing payroll processes for a growing organization, maintaining accurate financial records, and supporting a variety of accounting functions. The ideal candidate will have extensive payroll experience, strong accounting knowledge, and experience working in an organization with 50+ employees.

In addition to payroll administration, this position will support key accounting activities, including financial reporting, annual retirement plan reporting, audits, account reconciliations, and general bookkeeping functions. The successful candidate must be highly organized, analytical, and proficient in QuickBooks.



Key Responsibilities

Payroll Administration

- Process and manage payroll accurately and on time for a workforce of 50+ employees.

- Administer payroll using Gusto and ensure employee records, deductions, benefits, and payroll data are maintained accurately.

- Maintain payroll records and ensure compliance with applicable regulations and company policies.

- Review payroll data, timesheets, deductions, and adjustments for accuracy.

- Investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies and employee inquiries.

- Support payroll-related reporting and documentation requirements.



Accounting & Bookkeeping

- Maintain accurate financial records and general ledger transactions.

- Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable processes.

- Reconcile bank accounts, credit card accounts, and other balance sheet accounts.

- Record and categorize financial transactions in QuickBooks.

- Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.

- Assist with month-end and year-end closing activities.

- Support cash flow monitoring and financial analysis.



Compliance, Reporting & Audits

- Assist with annual retirement plan reporting and related documentation.

- Support internal and external audits by preparing schedules, reports, and supporting documents.

- Maintain compliance with accounting standards, company policies, and reporting requirements.

- Prepare and organize financial records for tax and regulatory requirements.

- Ensure financial documentation is complete, accurate, and audit-ready.



Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Accountancy, Accounting Technology, Finance, or a related field (required).

- Minimum of 3 years of payroll and accounting experience.

- Strong payroll processing experience, preferably for organizations with 50+ employees.

- Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks.

- Hands-on experience with Gusto Payroll or similar payroll systems.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other accounting software.

- Experience with financial reporting, reconciliations, and general ledger accounting.

- Experience supporting audits and annual reporting requirements.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

- Ability to manage sensitive and confidential information.

- Excellent organizational, communication, and time-management skills.



Schedule & Work Requirements

- Full-Time: 40 hours per week.

- Must be available to work during Pacific Standard Time (PST) business hours.

- Reliable internet connection and dedicated remote work environment required.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in the insurance industry.

- Experience administering payroll through Gusto for multi-state workforces.

- Familiarity with retirement plan reporting and compliance requirements.

- Experience supporting audit processes and financial reviews.

- Proven ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.



Employment Type: Full-Time

- Hours: 40 Hours per Week

description:
Remote Front-Office Coordinator — US Home-Services Companies (Full-Time, $15/hr)

- Answering incoming calls and messages from customers

- Scheduling and coordinating jobs on the calendar

- Following up on quotes and keeping customers in the loop

- General admin and organization to keep the owner out of the weeds

Down-to-earth American business owners — hardworking trades people who value reliability and a warm, professional voice on the phone.



Pay & schedule:



- $15/hour — full-time (roughly $2,600/month). We’re looking for the best and are willing to pay top-of-market.

- Fluent, clear, confident spoken and written English — you’re comfortable on the phone with customers

- Experience in admin, customer service, scheduling, dispatch, or a similar front-office role

— Marcus, Prairie & Palm Talent

- Produce live virtual events using platforms such as Restream, Zoom Webinar, StreamYard, or similar tools

- Manage technical execution of livestreams, including speaker onboarding, audio/video setup, transitions, and spotlighting

- Coordinate backend production workflows between streaming platforms and event/community systems

- Monitor live broadcasts and troubleshoot technical issues in real time

- Support webinar-style events typically ranging from 45–60 minutes in duration

- Handle production elements such as speaker camera management, slide transitions, livestream monitoring, technical troubleshooting, and backstage coordination

- Collaborate closely with internal event, education, and community teams

- Help scale operational processes as event volume grows globally



What You Won’t Need to Do

- Own event agendas or programming strategy

- Moderate audience chat or community engagement

- Run full-day conference productions

- Manage marketing or attendee acquisition

title: Senior Fitness Studio Client Operations & Billing Coordinator
description:
We are an established U.S.-based boutique fitness studio serving recurring clients through scheduled appointments, memberships and individual services.

This is not a basic virtual assistant or data-entry position.



We are looking for someone with significant administrative experience who can learn our business thoroughly and become the person we trust to keep our scheduling, billing, client accounts and administrative workflow accurate and organized.



For the right person, this is intended to be a long-term position.



Your Responsibilities



You will take primary responsibility for:



-Client scheduling, rescheduling and cancellations

-Creating simple administrative reports and tracking sheets when needed



-Keeping confidential client and business information secure



Who We're Looking For



We are looking for someone exceptionally accurate, responsible and proactive.



You should be the type of person who:



-Notices when numbers don't match



-Double-checks important work



-Keeps excellent records



-Follows a task through until it is completely resolved



-Notices potential problems before being asked



-Can manage many small details without losing track of them



-Learns systems and procedures quickly



-Is comfortable making decisions within established policies



-Communicates clearly and professionally with clients and team members



-Can work independently without constant supervision

Required Experience



-5+ years of professional administrative, operations, billing, scheduling or client-account experience preferred



-Strong experience working remotely



-Excellent written and spoken English



-Strong computer and technology skills



-Experience with scheduling, CRM, membership or practice-management software



-comfortable working with numbers, billing and account reconciliation



-Excellent attention to detail



-Experience supporting U.S.-based businesses strongly preferred



-Stable work history and professional references



-Experience in an appointment-based, membership-based, medical, wellness, fitness, spa or other client-service business is a plus.



Hours



-This is a part-time position.



-You must be consistently available for approximately a 2-hour working block between 10:00 AM and 2:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday through Thursday for time-sensitive scheduling, client communication and administrative needs.



-Additional administrative work may be completed more flexibly.



-We expect approximately 8–15 hours per week, depending on business needs. Hours may increase during busy periods and decrease during quieter periods.



-Please apply only if this schedule works for you consistently.



Compensation



$15–$20 USD/hour depending on experience and ability.



We are willing to pay at the top of the range for an exceptional candidate who has the experience and ability to independently take ownership of this role.



Long-Term Opportunity



We're not looking for someone to complete occasional tasks. We're looking for a dependable professional who can learn our business deeply, become an important part of our operations and stay with us long term.



How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1) A brief introduction and why this position interests you.



2) Your experience managing scheduling, billing and/or client accounts.



3) The software/CRM/scheduling systems you have used.



4) Your experience working for U.S.-based companies.



5) How long you worked with your two most recent long-term employers.



6) Confirmation that you can consistently work a 2-hour block between 10 AM–2 PM Eastern Time, Monday–Thursday.



7) Your desired hourly rate.



8) Please begin your application with the words “DETAILS MATTER.”



Applications that do not answer the questions above will not be considered.

title: Small-Business Sales & Business Development – Australian social media and AI services
description:
Small-Business Sales & Business Development – Australian social media and AI services (independent contractor)



We are a small Australian business that builds practical, AI-powered services for other businesses. We have services that work, and we need someone who loves selling to help more businesses find them.



This is a long-term independent contractor engagement, remote from the Philippines.



WHAT YOU WOULD SELL



1. An online social media posting service (main focus): a done-for-you service for Australian small businesses. We capture the owner's own voice and post regularly for them, so their business stays visible without them having to find the time.

2. AI and automation services (second focus): we help established Australian businesses (usually 10 or more office staff) remove repetitive admin work using AI and automation. Here your job is to find and qualify good prospects and book a conversation with our founder, who handles the detailed discussion and closes the deal.



WHAT THE WORK INVOLVES



- finding Australian small businesses that would genuinely benefit, and the right person to talk to;

- contacting them by message,
, LinkedIn and phone, and following up intelligently;

- explaining the posting service simply and honestly, handling questions and objections, and signing up clients;

- qualifying AI-services prospects and booking calls with the founder;

- keeping accurate records of every prospect and conversation; and

- telling us what you hear from the market, so we can improve the offer and the targeting.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- you genuinely enjoy selling and have done it successfully: you can show deals you closed yourself, not just calls made;

- excellent spoken and written English, comfortable talking with Australian business owners;

- experience selling to small-business owners (Australian or US) is highly desirable;

- good judgement: you can tell a real prospect from a waste of time, and say why; and

- organised and persistent with follow-up.



We are not looking for someone who runs their own agency or juggles several clients. We want someone who wants to build something with us over the long term.



FEES



US$4.50 per hour (about PHP 48,000 a month at around 40 hours a week), plus success fees for clients you bring in who sign up and pay. There are no targets in the first month while we learn together what works. You are an independent contractor: you choose when and how you work, and you invoice weekly for the work done.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the words SELL WHAT WE BUILD, then answer each question below. Applications that don't answer the questions will not be considered.



1. Describe your sales experience: what you sold, to whom, your exact part (finding prospects, booking meetings, closing), and your results with numbers.

2. Describe one deal you closed yourself with a small-business owner: what they bought, the price, how long it took, and what made them say yes.

3. A café owner tells you: "I post on
 myself when I get time." What do you say next, and why?

4. How would you find an established Australian business (10+ office staff) that might benefit from automating admin work, and who in that business would you contact?

5. Tell us about a time your sales approach wasn't working and you changed it. What did you change, and what happened?

6. Your DISC profile as four numbers that add up to 100, in the order D / I / S / C (for example 30 / 25 / 20 / 25).

7. Your CV, your availability, and confirmation that you're comfortable working as an independent contractor from the Philippines.



Shortlisted applicants will be asked for a short voice recording and invited to a PAID practical exercise.

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours 



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision: 

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business. 



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us! 



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager 



Role Purpose 

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time. 



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events. 



What Success Looks Like 

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance. 



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts. 



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution. 



Primary Objectives 

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System 

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR 

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment 

Competitive Advantage 

 

Regular Work Activities 

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails) 

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking 

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy 

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates 

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track) 

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content) 

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs 

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates 

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates 

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals 

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP) 

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration 

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR 

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required 

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals) 

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement 

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets) 

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing) 

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type) 

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed 

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list) 

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches) 

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues) 

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers) 

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination) 

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests) 



Key Skills 

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth) 

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions) 

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation 

Organized project management across many ASINs 

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating) 

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes 

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops) 

 

People Contacts and Interactions 

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment) 

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes) 

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions) 

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment 



Role Requirements 

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred) 

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent) 

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents) 

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work 

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline 

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back 



How to Apply:

Click the link - 

ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.

title: Sales Operations Support Coordinator
description:
About the role



We are looking for a curious, dependable and highly organized Sales Operations Support Coordinator to help keep our sales team running smoothly.



This role combines sales administration, process compliance, product training coordination and recruitment support. You will be trusted to follow tasks through from beginning to end, ask thoughtful questions when something is unclear and ensure that no detail is overlooked.



This position is ideal for someone who takes genuine pride in their work. You should be willing to help wherever reasonably required and understand that both small administrative tasks and larger projects contribute to the success of the team.



As our business evolves, you will also be expected to learn new areas and take ownership of agreed projects and reasonable duties across the wider business. This is a varied role for someone who is adaptable, willing to contribute wherever needed and equally committed to routine responsibilities and larger projects.



Key responsibilities

* Sales processes and compliance

* Conduct regular checks to ensure the sales team follows established standard operating procedures.

* Maintain clear checklists and records of completed compliance checks.

* Identify missing steps, documentation or follow-ups and address them promptly.

* Follow each matter through to completion rather than assuming someone else will finish it.

* Provide concise updates to management on recurring issues and areas requiring attention.

* Suggest practical process improvements when gaps or inefficiencies are identified.



Product training and knowledge base

* Prepare and organize training materials for new products.

* Upload, structure and maintain content in Zoho Learn.

* Keep the company knowledge base accurate, current and easy to navigate.

* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to obtain product files, specifications, images and other required information.

* Ensure relevant team members receive everything needed for product launches and sales training.

* Track outstanding information and follow up until it is received.

* Ask questions and confirm expectations whenever instructions or product information are unclear.



Recruitment support

* Prepare and post sales recruitment advertisements on SEEK and other approved channels.

* Review applications against agreed selection criteria.

* Conduct initial candidate screening by
, phone or video call.

* Maintain accurate candidate records and prepare clear shortlists for management.

* Coordinate interviews and communicate professionally with applicants.

* Handle applicant information responsibly and confidentially.



Daily roster and attendance support

* Prepare and monitor the team’s daily break roster.

* Check arrival times and attendance against agreed schedules.

* Record exceptions accurately and follow the appropriate escalation process.

* Communicate reminders professionally, consistently and fairly.

* Maintain accurate records so information can be easily reviewed when required.



Projects and evolving priorities

* Take ownership of new operational projects and change business priorities as assigned by management.

* Clarify the required outcome, scope, priority, deadline and stakeholders before commencing unfamiliar work.

* Turn instructions into a practical action plan with clear steps, responsibilities and due dates.

* Coordinate with internal team members, suppliers or other stakeholders as required.

* Track actions, dependencies and risks and provide clear progress updates.

* Ask questions and raise potential obstacles early rather than making assumptions or waiting until a deadline is missed.

* Carry projects through from initial instruction to completion, implementation and handover.

* Create or update the relevant SOP, checklist or supporting documentation when a project introduces a repeatable process.

* When project work competes with recurring responsibilities, confirm priorities with the manager so existing duties are not silently delayed or dropped.



General Operations: 

* Monitoring operations and reporting on performance.

* Helping implement new workflows, tools and processes.

* Troubleshooting operational issues.

* Coordinating across departments and with external suppliers.

* Analyzing information and preparing useful reports.

* Supporting onboarding and SOP training.



How we expect you to work



We are looking for someone who:

* Is naturally curious and wants to understand the reason behind a task.

* Asks sensible questions when unsure instead of guessing or remaining silent.

* Listens carefully and follows instructions accurately.

* Takes responsibility for tasks from commencement through to completion.

* Pays close attention to details and checks their work before submitting it.

* Is reliable, responsible and consistent—even when working independently.

* Follows established processes rather than creating unnecessary shortcuts.

* Completes all reasonable duties within the role instead of selecting only preferred tasks.

* Approaches small routine tasks with the same care as larger projects.

* Keeps files, trackers, messages and priorities organized.

* Communicates early if a deadline may be missed or assistance is required.

* Creates clear handover notes and ensures essential processes are covered before taking leave.

* Is honest, genuine and trustworthy in their communication and work.

* Accepts feedback positively and applies it to future work.

* Closes the loop by confirming when work has been completed.



Skills and experience

* At least two years’ experience in sales administration, operations support, recruitment coordination or a similar role.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

* Confidence in politely holding people accountable to agreed processes and deadlines.

* Ability to manage several recurring responsibilities without constant supervision.

* Experience maintaining SOPs, checklists, trackers or knowledge bases.

* Sound judgement when working with confidential recruitment and attendance information.

* Competence with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.

* Experience coordinating or managing projects from initial brief through to completion.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving and time-management skills.

* Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and processes quickly.

* Ability to work independently while knowing when to ask questions or escalate an issue.

* Experience identifying operational bottlenecks and recommending practical improvements.

* Experience with Zoho Learn, other Zoho applications, SEEK or an Australian business will be highly regarded but is not essential.



Working arrangements

* Location: Remote, Philippines

* Hours: Mondays to Fridays 9am-5.30pm

* Time zone: Australian Eastern Standard Time, including daylight-saving changes.

* Employment type: Full-time

* Salary: PHP 50,000 per month, plus 13th-month pay, paid leave and health-insurance benefits. 

* Start date: ASAP

* The successful candidate will require a reliable internet connection, a suitable home workspace and the ability to attend online meetings during the required working hours.



How to apply



Please submit:

* Your résumé.

* A short introduction explaining your relevant experience and why this role interests you.

* An example of a process, checklist, tracker or knowledge base you have maintained.

* An example of a task you managed from initial instruction through to completion.

* Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

* Your availability and notice period.



Please begin your application with the words “Sales Operations” so we know you have read the advertisement carefully.

title: Executive & Project Assistant
description:
PLEASE READ JOB POST IN ITS ENTIRETY 



Executive & Administrative Assistant



We are looking for someone who does more than complete assigned tasks.



We are looking for a responsive, resourceful, and highly organized Project & Administrative Assistant who can work directly with the Founder, support multiple areas of the business, and think beyond what is immediately in front of them.



This role is ideal for someone who naturally asks, “What needs to happen next?”



As you learn the business, we want you to become an extension of the Founder—someone who keeps track of moving pieces, notices what may be missing, follows through, and helps us stay a few steps ahead.



About NSM Consulting Group



NSM Consulting Group is a Washington, DC-based event production and consulting company. We support organizations through the planning and execution of events, programs, trainings, and special projects.



We are a growing small business, which means our needs can change from week to week. We value excellent work, strong communication, resourcefulness, flexibility, and people who take ownership of what they do.



Position Overview



The Project & Administrative Assistant will provide ongoing administrative, project, and event support to the Founder and NSM Consulting Group.



This is a flexible role. You may organize project files, maintain trackers, prepare invoices, conduct research, proofread client materials, prepare meeting resources, or help support a virtual event.



You will receive direction and training, but you will not always receive step-by-step instructions for every assignment. We need someone who can understand the desired outcome, use available resources, think through what may be needed, and ask thoughtful questions when necessary.



As the role develops, responsibilities may evolve based on the needs of the company.



Key Responsibilities



Organize and maintain digital files, folders, documents, and company records.



Maintain project trackers, task lists, deadlines, and follow-up items.



Prepare invoices, receipts, and basic administrative documentation.



Format, proofread, and review
s, presentations, documents, and client-facing materials.



Conduct research and summarize findings clearly.



Prepare materials and resources for meetings, client projects, and events.



Support virtual events, webinars, trainings, and meetings as needed.



Assist with attendee communications, registration lists, surveys, links, presentations, and other event logistics.



Track meeting notes, decisions, action items, and outstanding information.



Follow up on open items without waiting to be reminded.



Identify missing information, potential issues, or next steps and bring them forward proactively.



Help improve templates, systems, processes, and organization.



Learn and use new platforms or technology as business needs evolve.



Provide general project and administrative support as needed.



Required Qualifications



Previous experience providing administrative, project, executive, program, event, or similar professional support.



Strong experience using Google Workspace, including Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar, Gmail, and Meet.



Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.



Strong organizational and time-management skills.



Excellent attention to detail.



Ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.



Ability to work independently and take initiative.



Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills.



Ability to research and learn unfamiliar tasks, tools, or processes.



Ability to receive constructive feedback and apply it to future work.



Reliable access to a computer and stable internet connection.



Ability to protect confidential company and client information.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience supporting a founder, executive, entrepreneur, or small business.



Experience with project coordination or event support.



Experience supporting virtual events, webinars, or online trainings.



Experience with Canva.



Experience with invoicing, expense documentation, or basic business administration.



Experience with project-management platforms.



Experience working successfully with a remote team.



Experience working across multiple projects or clients simultaneously.



Specific software experience beyond Google Workspace is helpful but not required. The platforms we use may evolve, and the right person must be comfortable learning and adapting to new technology.



What Success Looks Like



You will be successful in this role when:



Assigned work is completed accurately and on time.



The Founder does not have to repeatedly follow up on assigned responsibilities.



Files, project information, and documentation remain organized.



Deadlines and open items are actively tracked.



Details are reviewed before work is considered complete.



Questions and potential problems are communicated early.



You make a reasonable effort to research and solve problems before immediately escalating them.



Feedback is reflected in your future work.



You begin anticipating reasonable next steps as you become familiar with the business.



You recognize when something may have been overlooked and bring it to the Founder's attention.



The Founder can trust that when something is assigned to you, it will either be handled or proactively communicated about.



You May Be a Strong Fit If You



Naturally think a few steps ahead.



Notice details other people may overlook.



Take ownership of your work from beginning to end.



Follow through on what you say you will do.



Are comfortable figuring things out when you do not immediately know the answer.



Know how to research, troubleshoot, and use available resources.



Ask thoughtful questions rather than waiting for every step to be provided.



Communicate proactively instead of disappearing when something becomes difficult.



Can balance flexibility with organization.



Receive direct feedback without becoming defensive.



Apply what you learn so the same correction does not have to be given repeatedly.



Take pride in doing excellent work even when no one is watching.



Most importantly, you are interested in becoming an extension of the Founder.



As you learn the business, we want you to recognize not only what you were asked to do, but also what may need to happen next.



Please Do Not Apply If You



Need repeated reminders to complete routine responsibilities.



Need detailed step-by-step instructions for every assignment.



Struggle to meet deadlines or communicate when something changes.



Regularly overlook details in documents,
s, dates, links, or instructions.



Stop when you encounter something you do not know how to do.



Are uncomfortable researching or learning independently.



Prefer to complete only the exact task assigned without considering obvious next steps.



Have difficulty managing changing priorities.



Are unwilling to accept constructive feedback or take ownership of mistakes.



Are looking for a role where the responsibilities will remain exactly the same.



Hours & Compensation



This is a part-time remote position starting at approximately 10 hours per week, with the potential to grow to approximately 20 hours per week as the role and business grow.



Some work can be completed on a flexible schedule. However, meetings, client needs, deadlines, and virtual events may require availability during specified U.S. Eastern Time hours.



The selected candidate will begin with a 30-day paid trial period. Successful completion of the trial period may lead to continuation in the ongoing part-time role.



TO APPLY



To be considered for this position, you must complete BOTH of the following:



1. Submit Your Application



Submit your application for the Project & Administrative Assistant position, including your résumé and any requested information.



2. Complete the Written Interview



Complete the NSM Consulting Group Written Interview using the Google Form below:




.com/applynsm



The written interview is a required part of the application process and gives us an opportunity to learn more about how you think, communicate, solve problems, and approach your work.



Your application will not be considered complete until both your application and the Google Form Written Interview have been submitted.



Candidates selected to move forward will be contacted for a virtual screening interview.



Please review all instructions carefully before submitting. We look forward to learning more about you.

title: Experienced Medical Coder — IV Infusion, Primary Care & Pediatrics
description:
Experienced Medical Coder — IV Infusion, Primary Care & Pediatrics

About Our Practice



We are a growing U.S. medical practice looking for an experienced medical coder and insurance authorization specialist to support our outpatient practices.



The ideal candidate will have strong experience with U.S. medical coding, claims review, insurance verification, prior authorizations, tracking, claim tracking, and denial prevention.



A major part of this position will involve office-based IV infusion coding and prior authorizations, as well as reviewing and correcting claims for our primary care and pediatric practices.



This is a hands-on coding position for someone who understands how medical services are actually documented, coded, billed, and reimbursed by U.S. insurance companies.



Position



Medical Coder / IV Infusion Authorization & Claims Specialist



Work arrangement: Remote Schedule: Part-time to start, with potential for additional hours Experience: Experienced U.S. medical coder required



Primary Responsibilities



IV Infusion & Specialty Therapy



You will be responsible for helping our practice properly authorize, code, and bill office-based infusion services.



Responsibilities include:



Verify insurance eligibility and benefits.

Determine whether infusion medications are covered under the medical or pharmacy benefit.

Determine whether prior authorization is required.

Obtain and manage prior authorizations.

Communicate with insurance companies and payer authorization departments.

Track authorization numbers, approved units/doses, effective dates, and expiration dates.

Identify appropriate CPT, HCPCS, J-code and ICD-10 codes.

Code IV infusion administration services.

Code hydration and injection services.

Understand time-based infusion coding.

Review medication units and dosage documentation.

Understand buy-and-bill medications.

Review documentation for medical necessity.

Identify payer-specific requirements.

Assist with infusion claim review before submission.

Identify potential denial, bundling, NCCI, modifier, and documentation problems.

Assist with appeals and denied infusion claims.

Primary Care Coding



You will also review and correct claims generated by our primary care practice.



Responsibilities include:



Review office visit claims for accurate CPT and ICD-10 coding.

Review E/M coding and documentation.

Evaluate diagnosis-to-procedure linkage.

Review preventive visits and wellness examinations.

Review problem-oriented visits.

Review immunizations and vaccine administration.

Review laboratory and diagnostic services.

Identify missing or incorrect modifiers.

Correct coding errors before claims are submitted.

Review denied claims and determine the appropriate correction.

Identify undercoding, overcoding, bundling, and documentation issues.

Review claims for payer-specific requirements.

Assist with claim edits and clearinghouse rejections.

Pediatric Coding



Experience with pediatric medical coding is highly preferred.



You may review claims involving:



Well-child visits

New-patient and established-patient visits

Preventive medicine services

Immunizations and vaccine administration

Developmental screening

Behavioral/developmental services

Acute sick visits

Chronic-condition management

Office procedures

Laboratory services

Pediatric diagnosis coding

E/M services

Modifier usage

You should understand the differences between preventive and problem-oriented services and know when appropriate modifiers are required.



Insurance & Prior Authorization



The ideal candidate should be comfortable working directly with U.S. insurance companies.



Experience with the following is preferred:



Medicare

Medicaid

Medicare Advantage

Commercial insurance

HMO/PPO plans

UnitedHealthcare

Aetna

Cigna

Blue Cross Blue Shield

Humana

Other regional and national payers

Experience with payer portals such as Availity, NaviNet, UHC portals, and other payer systems is a plus.



Required Coding Knowledge



Strong candidates should be comfortable with:



CPT

HCPCS Level II

ICD-10-CM

E/M coding

Modifiers

NCCI edits

Bundling/unbundling rules

Medical necessity

Diagnosis-to-procedure linkage

Claim edits

Clearinghouse rejections

Denials

Appeals

Payer-specific billing requirements

Certifications



Preferred certifications include:



CPC

CCS

CCA

CPMA

CRC

CIC

Other recognized medical coding certification

Certification is preferred but demonstrated real-world U.S. coding experience is more important.



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who can independently review a claim and determine:



Was the service documented correctly?



Was it coded correctly?



Does the diagnosis support the service?



Are the correct CPT/HCPCS/ICD-10 codes being used?



Is a modifier required?



Is the service bundled?



Does the payer require prior authorization?



Is the claim likely to be paid?



If the claim was denied, what needs to be corrected or appealed?



For infusion services, we also want someone who understands:



Medication → J-code/HCPCS → units → diagnosis → medical necessity → authorization → infusion administration CPT → documentation → claim submission.



What We Are NOT Looking For



This is not a general virtual assistant position.



Please do not apply if your experience is limited to:



Data entry

Scheduling

Answering phones

Basic insurance verification

Sending generic prior authorization requests

Basic medical billing without coding experience

We need someone who can actually review, edit, correct, and explain medical claims.



Application Questions



Please answer all of the following:



How many years of U.S. medical coding experience do you have?

Do you hold a CPC, CCS, CCA, CPMA, or other coding certification? Please specify.

How many years of experience do you have coding primary care claims?

How much experience do you have with pediatric coding?

Describe your experience coding E/M services.

Describe your experience with preventive/well-child visits and immunization coding.

How much experience do you have with office-based IV infusion coding?

What IV medications, biologics, IVIG, iron infusions, hydration therapies, or other infusion services have you coded?

Do you have experience with J-codes and HCPCS drug coding?

Do you have experience with infusion administration CPT codes?

Do you have experience obtaining prior authorization for IV infusion medications?

Have you worked with buy-and-bill medications?

Which insurance companies and payer portals have you worked with?

Describe one difficult claim you corrected or one denial you successfully resolved.

Which EMR and billing/clearinghouse systems have you used?

How comfortable are you reviewing a claim and identifying coding errors independently?

What hours are you available to work?

What is your hourly rate?

Paid Coding Test



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid practical coding test.



The test will include examples from:



Primary care

Pediatrics

Preventive visits

E/M services

Immunizations

Office procedures

IV infusion services

Insurance authorization

Denied claims

For the infusion portion, you may be asked to identify the appropriate CPT, HCPCS/J-code, ICD-10, units, modifiers, authorization requirements, and documentation needed.



We are looking for someone who can demonstrate real-world U.S. outpatient coding knowledge, not simply answer theoretical questions.



Long-Term Opportunity



We are looking for someone who can become a reliable part of our billing and revenue-cycle team.



The ideal candidate will eventually be able to:



Review claims before submission

Correct coding errors

Identify potential denials

Manage infusion authorizations

Assist with appeals

Research payer policies

Communicate coding issues to providers

Help establish coding and billing workflows

Improve overall claim accuracy and reimbursemen

title: Take-off Estimator, Plumbing and Irrigation Pipework (Remote)
description:
About us

Think Water Adelaide is an irrigation, pump and water solutions business in South Australia, part of the Think Water national network. Our projects team designs, supplies and installs irrigation systems for councils, sporting reserves, schools and commercial sites.



We are looking for a quantity surveyor or estimator to prepare pipework materials take-offs for our irrigation projects during busy tender periods. You do not need to be an irrigation specialist. If you have done take-offs for plumbing, hydraulics, fire services or civil pipework, your experience fits this role. You will work directly with our Business Development Manager, who will send you drawings and review your work.



What you will do

You will prepare materials take-offs and bills of quantities from PDF site drawings, cable run tables and specifications, including:

- Measuring mainline and lateral pipe lengths by size and type (HDPE poly and PVC)

- Counting valves, sprinklers, scour valves, valve boxes and fittings

- Working out cable quantities and wire connectors from cable run tables

- Building complete assemblies (valve tap-ins, backflow, master valve and flow sensor, sprinkler connections) from the drawing details and our common standard builds

- Flagging anything on a drawing that looks wrong, unclear or different to our standards, rather than guessing



What we provide

You will work in our Excel take-off workbook. It includes written instructions, our most common standard assemblies, and our product list with item codes, so you select products from a dropdown rather than typing them. Where a job needs something outside our standard range, you add it and flag it, and we source it. You will not need access to our internal systems.



What we need

- Proven experience doing quantity take-offs or BOQs, ideally for plumbing, hydraulics, irrigation or civil pipework

- Strong understanding of pipe, fittings and valve assemblies (electrofusion fittings, poly and PVC, solenoid valves, backflow devices)

- Confident measuring from PDF drawings.

- Strong Excel skills and close attention to detail

- Good written English and willingness to ask questions when something is unclear

- Able to meet agreed deadlines during tender periods

- Some availability during Adelaide business hours (Adelaide is 1.5 to 2.5 hours ahead of Philippine time, depending on daylight saving)



Experience with Australian projects or products is a bonus but not essential, as long as you can follow our instructions closely.



How the work is set up

- Part-time, as-needed work, 

- Rate: US$8 to $15 per hour, depending on experience. 

- Paid fortnightly based on hours logged

- You will sign a confidentiality agreement before receiving any project drawings. All drawings and project information must not be shared, stored outside the agreed location, or reused



To apply

Send a message with the subject line "Pipework Take-off Estimator" and include:

1. A short summary of your take-off experience and the types of projects you have estimated

2. The software you use for measuring drawings

3. An example take-off or BOQ you have prepared, with client details removed

4. Your availability during Adelaide business hours



Applications without the subject line or these details will not be considered.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid test take-off from a sample drawing.

title: Power BI Data & Inventory Analytics Specialist
description:
We are an established, fast-growing multi-channel e-commerce brand managing a catalog of approximately 450 active products. We partner with large-scale distributors and manage data pipelines across several retail platforms and independent web storefronts. Our business model relies on operational efficiency, data precision, and real-time capital allocation.



Position Overview

We are looking for a skilled Data Analytics & Inventory Specialist to build, optimize, and maintain an automated data pipeline using Power BI and the Microsoft Ecosystem.

Your primary mission is to consolidate data from multiple distinct sources—including daily/weekly distributor spreadsheets, multi-channel platform sales data, and advertising metrics—into a unified, clean, and highly automated decision system that guides our replenishment and tracking.



Key Responsibilities



 1. Multi-Channel Profitability Dashboards

 * Build a unified data model in Power BI aggregating data from various third-party platform exports, independent storefront datasets, and ad platform reports.

 * Standardize and map product variations across disparate channels into a single master product table to handle naming and SKU discrepancies.

 * Write DAX measures to calculate true net margins per item by accurately separating channel-specific overhead and marketing expenses.

 2. Automated Supplier Inventory Matching

 * Utilize tools like Power Automate to streamline data extraction from recurring email data dumps, auto-saving files to OneDrive or SharePoint.

 * Build automated "Buy Alert" modules that cross-reference incoming vendor stock levels against current internal inventory deficiencies to flag purchasing opportunities.

 3. Predictive Replenishment Forecasting

 * Structure robust data-cleaning steps in Power Query to normalize varying spreadsheet layouts and messy source files without breaking the primary dashboards.

 * Develop short-term and long-term moving velocity metrics to project exact depletion timelines and automate reorder point triggers.

 4. Capital Allocation & Budget Tools

 * Design interactive parameters (such as What-If sliders) to filter procurement metrics against fixed capital limits.

 * Program ranking models that dynamically prioritize item lists based on velocity, margin performance, and advertising efficiency.

 



 Required Technical Qualifications



* Strong proficiency in Power BI Desktop & Power BI Service (DAX data modeling and dashboard layout design).

* Proficiency with Power Query for advanced data cleansing, row filtering, cell normalization, and structural formatting.

* Familiarity or experience with workflow automation tools (such as Power Automate) for automated file management and ingestion.

* Extreme Attention to Detail: Our inventory health depends entirely on exact metrics. Missing data, uncleaned cells, or structural oversight in reporting cannot occur. Precision is always prioritized over speed.

* Experience or background in the e-commerce industry or multi-channel retail logistics is a major plus (knowledge of the Amazon ecosystem is highly valued but not strictly necessary).





 Missing a qualification? Apply Anyway!

If you match most of the requirements but are missing a specific tool or niche skill on this list, please do not let that stop you from applying! We value transparency, problem-solving skills, and a strong work ethic just as much as past experience.

If you are missing a specific tool (for example, you are a Power BI expert but have never used Power Automate for email workflows):



* Be upfront with us in your application. Tell us exactly which qualification you are missing.

* Let us know your learning plan. If you are willing and able to research, upskill, and fill in that specific knowledge gap over your first few weeks on the job, we are more than happy to give you the time and flexibility to do so.

title: Virtual Sales & Enrollment Specialist
description:
Job Title: Virtual Sales & Enrollment Specialist — Wake Up Humans



Company: Wake Up Humans LLC

Location: Remote

Pay: $2.50 USD per hour

Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week



ABOUT US



Wake Up Humans LLC is Dr. Steve Judson’s platform for personal growth, leadership, and purposeful living. Through coaching, online programs, podcasts, and educational content, we help people take responsibility for their lives and pursue meaningful growth.



Our coaching framework centers on six areas: Faith, Family, Finances, Fitness, Friends, and Fun.



Learn more at 
. Please review the website before applying.



ABOUT THE POSITION



We’re looking for a confident, personable, and organized Virtual Sales & Enrollment Specialist to help us reach our goal of 100 paid online coaching members.



Your primary responsibility is to identify potential members, start genuine conversations, understand their goals, follow up consistently, and guide qualified prospects through enrollment.



This is a sales-focused position. Success will be measured by both the quality of your conversations and the paid enrollments you help generate.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Identify potential members through social media, podcast audiences, existing
 lists, previous inquiries, past participants, and referrals.



Prioritize people who have shown interest in Wake Up Humans or personal development.



Start personalized conversations through approved company accounts and outreach channels.



Respond to relevant comments, messages, and program inquiries.



Ask thoughtful questions to understand each prospect’s goals, challenges, and interest in coaching.



Determine whether the program is a good fit before recommending enrollment.



Explain the program clearly using approved information about its features, pricing, and member experience.



Answer common questions and address objections professionally.



Maintain consistent, respectful follow-up with interested prospects.



Guide qualified prospects toward a decision, share enrollment links, and confirm completed sign-ups.



Coordinate with our team when a prospect needs additional information or a conversation with Dr. Judson.



Maintain an organized lead tracker or CRM with conversation notes, lead status, and next steps.



Submit daily activity reports and contribute ideas to improve outreach and enrollment results.



Assist with related sales administration as needed.



OUR SALES APPROACH



We want genuine conversations that help people determine whether Wake Up Humans is right for them.



Our process is:



Connect → Understand their goals → Qualify → Explain the program → Invite → Follow up → Enroll



Every interaction should be authentic, encouraging, confident, and professional. Use accurate program information, respect requests to stop contact, and avoid pressure tactics or promises of guaranteed results.



GOALS & DAILY EXPECTATIONS



You will help build and maintain a sales pipeline toward our goal of 100 paid members. Each workday will include prospecting, outreach, responding to inquiries, follow-up, enrollment support, and reporting.



Initial activity targets may include:



25 new prospects identified per day.



15 new conversations started per day.



20 follow-ups completed per day.



5 qualified prospects per day.



3–5 enrollment conversations per day.



These are starting targets and will be adjusted with the team based on response rates, lead quality, and results.



Your daily report should include new prospects, conversations started, follow-ups completed, qualified prospects, enrollment links sent, new paid members, and any questions or obstacles.



REQUIRED SKILLS



Sales & Enrollment: Experience guiding interested prospects through a sales process and asking for the sale professionally.



Lead Generation & Outreach: Ability to identify suitable prospects and start personalized conversations.



Customer Communication & Follow-Up: Strong written English, relationship-building skills, and organized follow-through.



ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS



Experience in online sales, appointment setting, customer service, or coaching program enrollment.



Comfortable communicating through social media messages,
, and video or phone calls when needed.



Ability to ask thoughtful questions, listen carefully, and respond naturally.



Confidence handling common objections without becoming pushy.



Strong organization and attention to detail.



Familiarity with spreadsheets or CRM tools.



Ability to work independently, meet goals, and communicate consistently with our team.



Willingness to receive feedback and practice sales conversations.



Reliable internet connection and your own computer.



Availability to work 40 hours per week.



Experience selling online courses, memberships, coaching, or personal development programs is a plus.



TRAINING



We will provide program information, brand guidance, approved messaging, and sales process training. You will learn what members receive, who the program serves, pricing, and common questions.



Training will include practice conversations and feedback before you begin independent outreach.



HOW TO APPLY



Please use “Wake Up Humans Enrollment Specialist” as your application subject line and include:



A short introduction and summary of your relevant sales experience.



Your résumé.



A link to a 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you qualify for this position. Tell us about your sales or outreach experience, how you approach follow-up, and why you would be effective at helping people enroll in Wake Up Humans.



Any sales results you can share, including your role in achieving them.



A list of the CRM, communication, and sales tools you have used.



Your availability and earliest start date.



Confirmation that you are comfortable with the starting rate of $2.50 USD per hour and available to work 40 hours per week.



A Loom video is required for your application to be considered. Please make sure your video link is accessible.



We’re looking for someone who enjoys connecting with people, follows through consistently, and is motivated to help grow the Wake Up Humans community.

title: Proofreader / Content Quality Reviewer – Remote
description:
We’re looking for a detail-oriented Proofreader / Content Quality Reviewer to review a variety of documents for accuracy, clarity, natural English, and adherence to specific guidelines.



The subject matter will vary from project to project, so we need someone who is comfortable learning new terminology and applying detailed instructions consistently.



Hours: Approximately 20–40 hours per week depending on workload

Compensation: Hourly

Location: Remote

Training: Paid training provided



*Responsibilities*

Proofread and review documents covering a variety of topics

Identify grammar, spelling, punctuation, wording, and terminology issues

Recognize when language is technically correct but does not sound natural to a fluent English speaker

Ensure documents follow project-specific criteria, terminology, formatting, and instructions

Maintain consistency across documents

Flag unclear, inaccurate, awkward, or potentially incorrect wording

Carefully review your work before submission

Learn and apply feedback from training and previous reviews



*What We’re Looking For*

Excellent written English and a strong understanding of natural English usage

Previous proofreading, editing, quality assurance, content review, or similar experience

Extremely detail-oriented

Strong ability to follow written instructions and established criteria

Comfortable working with unfamiliar topics and terminology

Able to research or verify terminology when necessary

Consistent and reliable

Able to work independently and meet deadlines

Comfortable receiving feedback and adjusting quickly

You do not need to be an expert in every subject area. We care more about your ability to learn terminology, recognize when something doesn’t sound right, follow guidelines precisely, and pay close attention to details.



*Application*

Please include:

Updated resume link

A brief description of your proofreading, editing, or content-review experience.

An example of the types of documents or content you’ve reviewed.

Your weekly availability.

Your desired hourly rate.

Your level of English proficiency and whether you are a native or near-native English speaker.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a brief paid or unpaid skills assessment before moving forward. Candidates who are selected will receive paid training.



**Please begin your response with “Spot the Error” so we know you read the complete description.**

title: Senior YouTube / Google Ads Media Buyer: Demand Gen + Lead Generation + Attribution
description:
We are looking for a senior performance marketer to build and manage YouTube/Google Ads lead-generation campaigns for an established Australian investment education business.

This is not an ecommerce ROAS role.

Our funnel is:

YouTube/Google → webinar registration → attendance → engagement → eventual purchase.

That means we care about downstream economics and lead quality, not just cheap clicks or cheap form fills.

We are looking for someone who has personally managed meaningful Google Ads spend and understands YouTube conversion campaigns in depth.

Initial scope

- Google Demand Gen with YouTube channel controls

- YouTube video creative

- image creative within Demand Gen

- Google Search

- custom segments

- Customer Match

- remarketing

- audience testing

- placement analysis

- creative testing

- budget allocation

- GA4/GTM coordination

- enhanced conversions

- GCLID and UTM attribution

- offline conversion feedback

- view-through and engaged-view behaviour

- ongoing reporting and optimisation

We use a CRM and track leads through registration, attendance and eventual purchase.

The first phase is a controlled test with meaningful five-figure monthly media spend. There is scope to scale materially if the economics work.

What the weekly role looks like

Review registrations and downstream lead quality by campaign, audience and creative.

Review search terms, audience segments and placements.

Make appropriate exclusions and budget changes.

Identify creative fatigue and brief new creative.

Work with the video editor and marketing lead to develop new hooks.

Reconcile platform-reported results with CRM results.

Report clearly on what happened, why you think it happened, what you are changing and what you expect to learn.

We want someone who thinks like an investor in media spend rather than someone who merely "optimises campaigns."

You should have

Strong hands-on Google Ads experience.

Direct experience with YouTube/Demand Gen campaigns.

Substantial lead-generation experience.

Experience optimising toward downstream conversions rather than only leads.

Strong conversion tracking knowledge.

Comfort with imperfect attribution and cross-device behaviour.

Excellent analytical ability.

Experience handling meaningful monthly spend.

The ability to explain decisions simply.

Experience in Australia, financial services, education, webinars or higher-ticket acquisition is an advantage.

Meta experience is also useful because this role could eventually cover both Google and Meta.

We do NOT want

Someone whose entire solution is Performance Max.

Someone who mainly runs ecommerce Shopping campaigns.

Someone who reports impressions, CTR and CPL without understanding what happened after the lead.

Someone who outsources the actual account work to an undisclosed junior.

In your application, answer the following

1. How much monthly Google Ads spend have you personally managed?

2. What percentage was lead generation rather than ecommerce?

3. Describe your most successful YouTube/Demand Gen lead-generation campaign.

4. What was the offer, spend, CPL and downstream business outcome?

5. Tell us about a campaign that failed and what you changed.

6. How do you handle offline conversions where a lead converts days or weeks later?

7. How would you distinguish poor targeting from poor creative from a poor landing page?

8. When would you use Demand Gen rather than Performance Max?

9. Please provide screenshots or redacted evidence where appropriate.

10. Confirm whether you personally will manage the account.

11. Your hourly rate or preferred monthly retainer.

Hiring process

Shortlisted candidates will be paid to complete an account/measurement review and present their proposed first 30-day plan.

We value clear thinking over a 70-page automated audit.

The successful candidate will initially work approximately 8–12 hours per week, with scope increasing as spend increases.
