title: Senior Project Manager – ERP Product Development & Launch (AU / UK / US)
description:
START DATE: MONDAY 12 OCTOBER 2026 – we are hiring fast.

If you are finishing a notice period, you can start part-time on Monday and move to full-time as soon as you're free. Tell us your availability in your application.



ABOUT US

JBI Electrical is an established Australian business building SPECit5 – a full ERP platform for medium-sized businesses, powered by our own Strategic Intelligence engine. Every client gets a system tailored to how their business actually runs. Our focus is trades, transport and logistics businesses in Australia, the UK and the US.



We believe the future of business is automated admin. Every job flow, from first enquiry to final payment, has steps that need a person and steps a system should handle. People stay essential for building trust with customers, making the call on site, leading teams, and the skilled hands-on work of electricians, plumbers and drivers. The system should handle the rest – data entry, chasing, scheduling, paperwork and compliance. SPECit5 is built to automate the right steps and give people more time for the work only they can do.



THE ROLE

This is a Philippines-based, full-time remote role. You will own delivery of SPECit5 and its first working release MUST be delivered within 8 weeks of you starting. After launch you will lead the international rollout.



WHO YOU ARE

- A Master of the End Game (MOTEG). You start with the finished result and work backwards. You keep the end goal in view when things get messy and you don't stop until it's delivered and working – not just "done".

- You never settle for average. "Good enough" isn't good enough.

- You take full ownership of results and don't make excuses.

- You raise problems early rather than hiding them.

- You share our vision: you can look at any job flow and see which steps are people-to-people or hands-on work, and which are admin and overhead a system should take over.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Run every SPECit5 product and build: roadmap, sprints, priorities, progress and blockers

- Manage developers, designers and specialist contractors (in-house and outsourced)

- Turn business needs into clear specs, user stories and acceptance criteria across the ERP's modules

- Use your knowledge of Simpro, Xero and similar tools to shape features, find competitive gaps and plan data migration for clients switching over

- Own the launch: testing, user acceptance, go-live, client onboarding and post-launch fixes

- Run go-to-market and marketing for Australia, the UK and the US: positioning, website, landing pages, campaigns and sales enablement

- Report weekly to the General Manager on progress, risks and what's needed to stay on schedule



WHAT YOU MUST HAVE

- 5+ years managing software or SaaS product builds from idea to launch

- A solid understanding of how western businesses operate – direct experience working with Australian, UK or US companies, their management styles, customer expectations, compliance and how they buy software

- A strong grasp of how trades, transport and logistics businesses run – quoting, job scheduling, dispatch, fleet and asset tracking, field staff, supply chains, invoicing and compliance

- The ability to spot real operational pain points and turn them into a clear picture of what the ideal system should do, from the business owner down to the person in the field

- Hands-on experience with ERP, business management or multi-module B2B platforms

- A track record of shipping on tight deadlines, with examples you can show

- B2B go-to-market and marketing experience in Australian, UK or US markets

- Strong Agile/Scrum skills plus Jira, ClickUp, Asana or similar

- Excellent written and spoken English, and confidence to push back and make calls

- Reliable internet and backup power

- Core availability during Australian business hours (AEDT), with flexibility for some UK and US calls



HIGHLY PREFERRED

- Deep knowledge of Simpro and Xero – how businesses use them day to day, where they fall short, and how they work together

- Experience with ServiceM8, fleet management, TMS or WMS software

- Experience launching a product in more than one country



PAY

AUD $2,500 per month plus a monthly performance bonus for hitting agreed milestones.



HOW TO APPLY

 
 with the subject line "SPECit5 PM – [Your Name]" and include:



1. Your CV

2. A short summary of one B2B software product you led to launch: the deadline, team size, what went wrong and how you still delivered

3. Your answers to these questions:

   a) You have 8 weeks to get the first working release of an ERP live and the scope keeps growing. What do you do in your first 2 weeks?

   b) A key developer misses two sprint deadlines in a row. How do you handle it?

   c) How would you launch a B2B ERP across Australia, the UK and the US on a small budget? Which market and industry would you start with, and why?

   d) Describe the western business you've worked with most closely and one thing about how it operated that surprised you. If you've used Simpro or Xero, list their three biggest weaknesses for a medium-sized trade or logistics business and how SPECit5 should do better.

   e) Pick a trades, transport or logistics business you know well and map one job from first enquiry to getting paid. For each step: who does it today and what's the pain point? Should it stay with a person, be fully automated, or a mix – and why? With the perfect system, what would that step look like? Then explain how that would change the day for the owner, the office staff and the people in the field.

   f) Tell us about a time a project was "finished" by everyone else's standard, but you knew it wasn't right. What did you do, and what was the result?

4. A 2-minute video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself



Applications without the correct subject line or all four items will not be reviewed.



OUR PROCESS

Shortlisted applicants must score 8/10 or higher on their application and 8/10 or higher on a paid practical test before the final interview. We are moving fast – applications close 7 days after posting.

title: Business Development & Growth Specialist
description:
About Glow Up Hub

Glow Up Hub is an AI platform for beauty salon owners. Owners upload their own policies and procedures, and their staff get instant, accurate answers from the platform instead of texting the boss. We are a small, founder-led team getting ready to launch.



The role

Your goal is to get as many salons signed up as possible, by any ethical route that works. That includes everyday salons who sign up on their own/ low touch point, larger accounts (franchises and chains, salon groups with three or more locations, top tier accounts), and sales driven by influencers, beauty coaches, affiliates and referral partners, plus media and PR outreach and award entries, which are a main part of the role. All your communication is written, by
 and message, with no phone calls. You will be measured on paying salons signed up through your channels with bonuses/ pay increases to be determined after an agreed upon amount of time.



What you will do

Your work falls into six areas: everyday salons, larger accounts, influencers, beauty coaches and affiliates, referrals and partnerships, media, PR and awards, and reporting.





Everyday salons (low touch/ no touch signups),



Find independent salon owners across Australia and New Zealand, and message them with a clear reason to try Glow Up Hub and a link to sign up. Getting stand alone salons signing up will be your main focus initially

Join salon owner groups and communities, and turn useful conversations into signups

Follow up with people who showed interest or started signing up but did not finish, using lists we share

Reply personally to warm leads and interested salon owners from social, ads and groups, so no interest goes cold

Test new channels and report which ones bring in paying salons at the lowest effort





Larger accounts (top tier and enterprise),



Build target lists of franchises and chains, salon groups with three or more locations, and large salons likely to suit the top tier. This will be further into your role once we have a certain amount of salons already signed up

Reach out by
, LinkedIn and Instagram, and follow up until you get an answer (within reason)

Arrange demos with the founders by message, with notes on each prospect including their pain points

Support larger deals with proposals, follow-ups and answers to common objections





Influencers, beauty coaches and affiliates,



Find and approach beauty coaches, salon coaches, beauty educators, industry creators and salon owners with an engaged audience

Build our affiliate program from scratch and manage it, including tracking links, payouts and the information partners need to promote us

Onboard new affiliates and partners with a welcome message, their tracking link and the assets they need

Check in with partners regularly, and follow up with any who go quiet

Brief influencers and track what each one brings in with reports





Referrals and partnerships,



Build and run a referral program from scratch for existing salons





Media, PR and awards,



Build and maintain a media list of trade press, small business and startup outlets, mainstream business media, podcasts and newsletters that reach salon owners

Send our pitches, using the story angles and drafts we provide, and write new pitches for news such as launches, milestones and customer results

Follow up until you get a reply, and pass any interview or feature request to the founders straight away

Find and enter relevant awards, such as beauty, small business, startup and technology awards, and write the entries using the information we provide

Pursue speaking, podcast and newsletter opportunities where salon owners are listening

Track every outlet, pitch, award and response in the CRM, including award deadlines





Reporting,



Keep a simple CRM of every prospect, partner and affiliate, and what stage they are at

Send a short weekly report: outreach sent, replies, meetings booked, signups from each channel, and what to try next



What success looks like

title: Meta ads Video editor
description:
About us



We’re an e-commerce brand that makes work pants and workwear for tradespeople in the UK and US. We’ve sold 156,000+ pairs. We run a high-volume creative system on Meta 
 and Instagram). Our scripts are written and finished before they reach you, so your job is to turn them into ads that stop the scroll and sell.



What you’ll be editing



Every batch comes as a written brief that includes:



- A reference ad, which is a proven winning ad (a Google Drive link). We match its pacing, structure and feel closely, but we don’t copy it.

- 5 hooks and one shared body script. You cut 5 versions of the same ad with a different opening each time.

- A beat-by-beat breakdown with the line spoken, the visual direction and the on-screen text for each beat.

Our B-roll bank and assets, so you aren’t starting from nothing.



Ads are usually 20 to 60 seconds and vertical (9:16). The format changes from batch to batch, and you need to be able to make all of them, including:



- UGC-style rants and customer testimonials

- AI talking heads (an AI-generated person speaking to camera)

- AI podcast clips (two hosts at a mic, discussing the product)

- Claymation and other stylised AI animation

- Skits and POV ads

- Brand comparisons (us vs. the competition)

- Whatever new format is working that week, matched to the reference ad



Responsibilities



- Edit 5-hook batches of short-form vertical video ads from a written brief and reference ad

- Follow the brief exactly. Scripts are already approved, so you don’t change wording or claims.

- Build AI-generated formats from scratch in Higgsfield (talking heads, podcast scenes, claymation, generated footage and product shots) when the reference ad calls for it

- Use ElevenLabs for AI voiceovers that sound natural, with the right accent, emphasis and delivery

- Add captions and on-screen text overlays in our house style (sentence case, clean, readable on mobile)

- Add sound effects and music that suit the pace of the ad

- Turn revisions around quickly

- Name and organise files exactly as instructed



Requirements



- 2+ years editing short-form ads (Meta, TikTok or UGC-style direct response). Organic content alone isn’t enough.

- You must already know how to use Higgsfield and ElevenLabs. These are the platforms we use, and we won’t train you on them. Please confirm in your application that you’ve used both and say what you’ve made with them.

- Range across formats. You can go from a UGC rant to an AI podcast to a claymation ad without it looking amateur.

- Strong English comprehension. You need to hear and feel the pacing, accent, emphasis and tone of a UK or US voice. You’ll be matching a reference ad’s delivery and directing AI voiceovers, so a voice that’s slightly off kills the ad.

- Proficient in Premiere Pro, CapCut or DaVinci Resolve

- You understand what makes a hook work in the first 3 seconds, along with pacing, pattern interrupts and retention

- Attention to detail. Our briefs are specific, and the small things matter. To show us you read this far, write “blue folder” somewhere in your application.

- Reliable internet and a capable computer

- Comfortable working with Google Drive and Google Sheets

- Willing to complete a paid trial task before being hired (details below)



Nice to have



- Experience editing ads for apparel, workwear or e-commerce brands



Our hiring process (all steps required)



Apply with:

- Your portfolio: ad work only, with links to at least 3 ads you edited, plus a screenshot of the editing timeline for each one. We want to see how you build an edit, not just the finished result. Bonus points if at least one is a fully AI-generated format (talking head, podcast, claymation, etc.).

- A short video of yourself (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself, your editing experience, and the AI tools you use. Upload it to Google Drive, Loom or YouTube (unlisted is fine) and include the link.

- Genius U personality test. Take the free Genius Test here: 
. Include your result (your profile name plus a screenshot or link) in your application.

- Video interview. Shortlisted applicants will have a recorded or live video interview with us.

- Paid trial task ($7.50 USD). You’ll edit one real brief from our system: 1 body script and 2 hooks, using our B-roll bank. You get paid for it whether or not you’re hired.



How to apply



Include:



- Portfolio links (ads only) with timeline screenshots for each

- The link to your video introduction

- To check you're paying attention write “blue folder” somewhere in your application

- Confirmation that you can use Higgsfield and ElevenLabs, with what you’ve made in each

Confirmation that you’re willing to do the $7.50 paid trial task

title: Technical Support & Client Onboarding Specialist (GoHighLevel)

PROGRESSION

WHO WE ARE

Pipereply builds and runs customised CRM systems for Australian solar and trade businesses, built around GoHighLevel with custom automations, integrations and AI assistants. We are a small remote team with a relaxed, no-BS culture, high standards and long-term relationships.



THE ROLE

Two halves:

1. Support. Work our help desk: workflow issues, form and calendar problems, integration failures and client questions. Find the cause, fix it properly, and confirm it is fixed before you close it.

2. Client calls. Run short video calls (30-60 minutes) with new clients to set them up on our new product, and walk existing clients through features such as calendars. You are the friendly, clear voice of Pipereply on these calls.



WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE HERE

- Experience with OpenAI or Anthropic tools.



WHY WORK WITH US

- Daytime hours in the Philippines.

- A transparent level structure with written criteria for each pay step. You will know exactly how to earn more.

- Long-term work with a small team that values quality over speed.



EXPECTATIONS

title: Real Estate Operations Manager
description:
Real Estate Operations Manager: 



We are a nationwide real estate investment company looking for an exceptional Real Estate Operations Manager with prior Transaction Coordinator experience.



Prior TC experience is REQUIRED. Experience with wholesaling, novations, or real estate investing is strongly preferred.



This role is for someone who is excellent at the mechanics of transactions but is also an exceptional problem solver.



We do NOT want someone whose job ends at sending paperwork, updating a CRM, and reminding people about deadlines.



We want someone who owns the transaction from signed contract through closing.



----



What You'll Own:



- All seller communication after contract

- Title/escrow/attorney coordination

- Agent and MLS coordination

- Inspections, access, showings and lockboxes

- Payoffs, liens, title problems and missing documents

- Buyer/lender/closing issues

- Transaction deadlines and follow-up

- Sellers becoming nervous, confused, frustrated or wanting to back out

- Problems threatening the transaction

- Keeping every party moving toward closing

- Escalating to the owner only when his actual authority or judgment is required



The Most Important Part: Problem Solving



We are specifically looking for someone who solves problems instead of reporting problems.



----



Musts: 



- Previous Transaction Coordinator experience

- Experience managing real estate transactions from contract through closing

- Strong understanding of title/escrow/closing processes

- Exceptional problem-solving ability

- Excellent seller/customer communication

- High emotional intelligence

- Strong assertiveness and persistence

- Excellent organization and attention to detail

- Ability to handle difficult conversations without becoming flustered

- Ability to make decisions independently within your authority

- A habit of relentlessly following up until something is resolved

Wholesale, novation, acquisitions/dispositions, or investor transaction experience is a major advantage.



------



The Personality



We're looking for an empathetic bulldog.



You can spend 20 minutes calming down an anxious seller and make them feel completely heard.



Five minutes later, you can call a title company for the third time that day because we're still waiting on something required to close.



You're kind without being passive.



You're assertive without being abrasive.



And when something goes wrong, your instinct is:



“I'll figure it out.”



----



To Apply



Please answer:



1. How many real estate transactions have you personally coordinated from contract through closing?

2. What types of transactions have you handled? Include wholesale, novation, cash, retail/MLS, creative finance, etc.

3. Tell us about the hardest transaction problem you've personally solved. What happened, what did YOU do, and what was the outcome?

4. A seller calls and says, “I've changed my mind. I'm not selling anymore.” Walk us through exactly how you would handle the conversation and what you would do afterward.

5. Tell us about a transaction you personally saved that otherwise might not have closed.

Generic applications will not be considered.



We are hiring for transaction experience, judgment, persistence, empathy, and extreme ownership—not someone who simply processes paperwork.

title: Custom Sports Apparel Designer — Sublimated Team Wear (Long-Term Contract)
description:
Type of Work: Graphic Design Service Fee: $1,000 – $1,500/month USD, based on experience. Exceptional senior candidates may be considered above this range. Coverage required: You organize your own working time, but must maintain a 2-hour overlap with our US team on our business days, inside our window of 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. US Central Time, for customer communication and handoffs. Company holidays and your own paid days off are excluded. We agree the exact window with you at the start.



About Us

Stitches & Dye, Oh My! is a US-based custom apparel company. We create original designs for bowling leagues, tournaments, and teams. Customers come to us with colors, an idea, and sometimes a reference photo, and we design something original for them. Our third-party vendor handles production.



We produce a full range: bowling jerseys, polos, t-shirts, hoodies, hats, and accessories. Bowling jerseys are our

specialty and the most technically demanding piece.



What You Will Own

• Create original apparel designs from a customer brief

• Present concepts to the customer and run the revision conversation with them directly

• Translate vague feedback ("make it more aggressive," "the logo feels small") into specific design changes

• Prepare print-ready files to our vendor's template and spec

• Submit approved files to the vendor and answer their production questions

• Update the order record after each customer exchange so our E-Commerce, Customer Operations & Social

Media Contractor always knows where the design stands

• On request, supply specialized apparel and product design assets for social media. Routine social content is

owned by that same contractor, not you.



Our service standard: first concept within two of our business days after a complete brief, and each revision within two of our business days after complete customer feedback. The clock does not start until the brief or feedback is complete.



Requirements

Must have:

• Strong Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop skills. Canva alone is not enough.

• Portfolio showing custom apparel or team sportswear. Include jerseys or uniforms if you have them.

• Experience preparing files for sublimation or DTF printing: vector artwork, correct color mode, bleed, seam and

panel placement, roster names and numbers

• Excellent written English. You will email our customers directly.

• Ability to work from a written brief and vendor spec sheet without constant supervision

• Judgment to stop and ask when a brief or a supplied file has a problem

• Computer that runs Adobe software well and reliable internet



Nice to have:

• Bowling, sports team, or league apparel experience

• Product or apparel mockup and presentation experience



What We Provide

• Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva, and Shutterstock accounts

• Payment via Wise, twice monthly. The 1st–15th is paid on the 25th; the 16th–end of month is paid on the 10th of the following month. We cover all transfer fees, so you receive the full amount.

• Company-funded Maxicare PRIMA or MediCard Health Plus after 90 days, subject to provider eligibility

• Paid Service Days: first earned at Day 120, then one for each 30 days of service after that

• Paid Non-Service Days on US and Philippine dates, per our published annual calendar

• Annual Service Bonus equal to one month's fee, earned every 12 months of service



This is a long-term, non-exclusive independent contractor engagement. You organize your own working time. For your first month our lead designer reviews every file before it goes to the vendor. After that you gain independence.



How to Apply

Subject line: APPAREL DESIGNER — [Your Name]

Include:

1. Portfolio link with apparel work clearly marked

2. Your experience preparing files for sublimation printing

3. Which Adobe programs you use most and your version

4. Your available overlap hours in US Central Time

5. Answer this: A customer says they want "something with blue and gold, kind of aggressive looking, with an

eagle." What three questions would you ask before you start designing?



Applications without an answer to #5 will not be reviewed.



Finalists receive a paid two-part test project using a real past order.



THE PAID TESTS

Both roles get a paid work-sample test. Portfolios and interviews show the best version of a candidate; a test shows what they do under your constraints. 



Before you send any test materials

Finalists have not signed the contractor agreement, so Sections 5 through 7 do not protect anything you hand them. Two things to do first.



Send a Paid Test Acknowledgment and get a reply agreeing to it:

Test materials provided by Stitches & Dye, Oh My! LLC are confidential and may be used only for this hiring exercise. They may not be posted, shared, added to a portfolio, reused, or distributed, and must be permanently deleted when the hiring process concludes or earlier upon Company's request. Finalist will confirm deletion in writing upon request. Any work product you produce for this test is for evaluation only and will not be commercially used by Stitches & Dye unless separately agreed in writing.



That last sentence protects the finalist as much as you, and saying so removes any ownership argument with someone who never becomes your contractor.



Substitute the identifying artwork. Removing a customer's name does not anonymize the order when their team logo is on the jersey. Replace the real logo with a fictional or Stitches & Dye-owned one. The real brief, the garment, the template problem, and the revision history all still work as a test without the actual customer's identity attached.

title: META ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATOR/EDITOR
description:
META ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATOR/EDITOR

We're looking for an AI video generator/editor who understands one thing clearly:



A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for someone who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels.



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:



AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.



You should know how to make videos that:



Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds

Make the problem feel real and urgent

Show the product clearly and persuasively

Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase

You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes… then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.



THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:



Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them

Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

Can create multiple ad variations quickly

Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good

We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:



HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use

You also have experience with:



Meta/Facebook ad creatives

Short-form paid social videos

Long-form VSLs or sales videos

Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools

Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.

Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

title: Senior Developer
description:
## Senior Developer



WordPress, Astro and AI-assisted development



Creative Nomads is looking for a senior developer with the judgment to take ownership of complex web work from investigation through launch. You'll work across custom WordPress development, architecture, integrations, modern frontends, and the systems that help our team deliver reliably.



You should be comfortable stepping into someone else's code, learning an unfamiliar system, finding the real cause of a problem, choosing a practical solution, and leaving the next developer with clear documentation. We use AI in our work and expect you to use it thoughtfully while taking responsibility for the code, security, and results.



You'll work with our technical lead, developers, designers, QA team, and delivery managers. The goal is to give the team another senior developer who can own difficult work, help others improve, and turn prototypes and technical ideas into dependable releases.



This is a full-time role paying $10 USD/hour from day one. There is a performance review at 90 days, with no automatic pay increase.



The exact weekly-hour count, worker classification, working-time overlap, start date, and benefits will be confirmed separately.



## What you will own



- Build and extend WordPress websites with custom PHP, plugins, themes, JavaScript, APIs, and integrations. Work effectively with established builders while knowing when a custom solution is appropriate

- Build and maintain Astro frontends and CMS integrations, with attention to content structure, reusable components, responsive behavior, accessibility, and performance

- Investigate production and staging issues across PHP, plugins, databases, forms,
 delivery, APIs, caching, and hosting. Reproduce the problem, find the cause, verify the fix, and document it

- Investigate existing applications and inherited code without defaulting to a rewrite. Learn the architecture, trace behavior and dependencies, test your understanding, and turn uncertain requirements into small, testable implementation steps

- Plan safe CMS migrations. Preserve content relationships, URLs, redirects, access rules, media, and important user flows, and verify results before cutover

- Design maintainable integrations, including authentication, authorization, validation, retries, duplicate prevention, useful logs, and failure handling

- Improve development and release workflows using Git, pull requests, automated checks, staging, deployment verification, monitoring, and rollback plans

- Use AI coding tools to speed up investigation and implementation. Inspect generated code, verify behavior, protect client information, and explain your decisions

- Help automate repetitive WordPress maintenance with explicit permissions, tested backups, staged changes, and clear stop conditions

- Keep ClickUp work current, raise blockers early, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and help other developers solve recurring problems



## What you need to bring



- Evidence of independently delivering and supporting production WordPress work that goes beyond page-builder configuration

- Strong practical PHP, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and SQL skills, including the ability to read and debug an unfamiliar codebase

- Evidence of learning an unfamiliar system through code, documentation, data and targeted experiments, then making sound architecture or implementation decisions

- Experience building or maintaining custom WordPress plugins, hooks, themes, REST endpoints, or comparable integration-heavy WordPress functionality

- Working ability with Astro and a headless CMS workflow, including how content is built, previewed, fetched, and published

- Sound judgment around server-side authorization, validation, secrets, database changes, backups, and safe production access

- Practical Git, command-line, hosting, and deployment experience; comfort investigating logs and working with SSH and WP-CLI under appropriate access controls

- A repeatable approach to testing that covers expected behavior, failures, and regressions rather than relying only on visual inspection

- Demonstrated use of AI in real development work, with the ability to explain where it helped, what it got wrong, and how you checked the output

- Clear written communication, dependable follow-through, and the judgment to surface uncertainty before it becomes a missed commitment



## Experience that will help



- Taking over unfamiliar CMS or application code, documenting its behavior, and delivering a safe improvement or migration

- Sanity, Django or Wagtail, TypeScript, and other modern application frameworks

- GridPane, Cloudflare, CI/CD, uptime monitoring, and automated form or browser testing

- Membership systems, gated content, payment-provider integrations, CRM integrations, and complex forms

- Building guarded automation or MCP tools with scoped access, logs, approval boundaries, and recovery paths

- Mentoring developers and creating documentation that reduces repeat troubleshooting



We value your ability to learn and reason about an unfamiliar system. You do not need prior experience with every platform you may encounter here.



## What good work looks like here



- You clarify the outcome and important constraints before building

- Your changes are small enough to review, and your handoffs include evidence of what you tested

- You can explain what is ready, what is still risky, and what decision or access you need

- You protect existing user flows and data when changing or migrating a system

- The team can understand, operate, and maintain what you ship

- Your work makes the technical lead and the rest of the team more effective



## How to apply



Send a short introduction and two or three relevant examples. For each example, explain the problem, your personal contribution, the important technical decisions, and how you knew the result worked.



Please include:



1. A WordPress project involving custom code or a substantial integration

2. A difficult bug or production issue you personally diagnosed and resolved

3. A modern frontend, migration, or delivery-automation example, ideally involving Astro or a headless CMS



Public links are helpful. If the work is confidential, provide a redacted walkthrough or a small representative example you are allowed to share. Do not send credentials, private client data, or code you do not have permission to disclose.



Tell us your availability, working-time overlap, and when you could start. Shortlisted applicants will complete a scenario-based assessment and technical discussion. If a later coding practical is requested, its scope, time limit, and payment terms will be shared before it begins.

description:
Role Hours: 9:00AM-6:00PM EST



H&C is hiring a hands-on VP of Operations to take ownership of daily operations, supervise our remote legal support team, and reduce the founder's involvement in routine task management.



This is a working leadership role in a small legal support business. You will organize work, investigate blockers, review deliverables, coach staff, and follow tasks through to verified completion. Success means the founder receives clear recommendations and work ready for review without having to direct every step.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• Turn attorney and client instructions into clear assignments with an owner, source documents, priority, deadline, and expected deliverable.

• Manage daily priorities and workload; supervise, train, and hold remote staff accountable for quality and follow-through.

• Resolve routine questions by reviewing instructions,
 threads, matter records, and existing procedures before escalating.

• Review drafts and filing packets for correct names, case numbers, dates, calculations, attachments, completeness, and consistency with source documents.

• Track document requests, intake, discovery support, filing receipts, calendaring, billing support, and outstanding approvals.

• Distinguish drafted, approved, submitted, accepted, and completed work. Verify completion in the relevant source system.

• Build and improve practical SOPs, checklists, and handoff procedures. Preserve established
 templates and the founder's communication style.

• Keep each client firm's records, accounts, communications, and workflows separate and confidential.

• Provide one concise daily operations summary covering completed work, approaching deadlines, unresolved blockers, and decisions needed. Escalate urgent issues promptly.



WHAT YOU MUST BRING

• Demonstrated experience leading remote staff and owning operations in a law firm or legal support environment.

• Strong legal administrative workflow knowledge and the ability to review support work against source records. This role does not require you to be a U.S. attorney.

• Specific examples of assigning work, correcting errors, coaching staff, and improving a process without constant owner involvement.

• Excellent written and spoken English, sound judgment, careful attention to detail, and reliable follow-through.

• Experience with task management, document management,
, spreadsheets, and legal practice software. Clio, Smokeball, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and U.S. litigation or family-law support experience are valuable.

• Reliable internet, a suitable remote workspace, and consistent overlap with U.S. Central business hours.



AUTHORITY AND JUDGMENT

You will own routine operational decisions within agreed procedures. Substantive legal decisions remain with the supervising attorney. External communications, filings, billing changes, and other final actions must follow the specific approvals established for each client. When a decision is needed, bring the issue, what you checked, your recommended next step, and a prepared draft when applicable.



FIRST 30 DAYS

Learn the existing workflows, take over daily team coordination, establish reliable task and approval tracking, resolve recurring operational blockers, and demonstrate that work can move forward with substantially less routine input from the founder.



HOW TO APPLY

Begin your application with OPERATIONS and answer these questions:

1. What legal operations and remote team leadership experience do you have? How many people did you directly supervise, and what were you accountable for?

2. Describe a process you took over from a founder or attorney. What changed, and how did you measure the result?

3. Give a specific example of reviewing and correcting an employee's work. How did you prevent the error from recurring?

4. An assistant says a document is missing and a task is due today. What would you investigate and do before contacting the founder?

5. What are your current work commitments, availability during U.S. Central business hours, and earliest start date?

6. What is your desired hourly or monthly rate in USD?



Include your resume and, if available, a redacted SOP, task tracker, or quality checklist you created. Do not include confidential client information. Shortlisted applicants will complete an interview and a practical exercise using fictional information.

* Verify freight and warehouse invoices

* Identify incorrect charges and duplicate invoices

* Investigate discrepancies

* Follow up with suppliers when something doesn’t look right

Payroll & Australian Compliance

* Superannuation

* Working with the business accountant

* Monthly P&L reporting

* Cash-flow reporting

* Basic cash-flow forecasting

* Monitoring upcoming supplier payments and commitments

* Flagging unusual expenses or financial movements

* Helping management understand where money is being spent



Systems & Process Improvement



This is not a role where you simply reconcile Xero and finish for the day.



We want someone who can help improve the way the finance function operates.



You will be expected to:



* Create and maintain finance SOPs

* Document processes clearly

* Identify repetitive manual tasks

* Find opportunities for automation

* Use AI and technology to improve workflows

* Improve how information moves between Shopify, Xero, suppliers and the team

* Reduce errors and save time

* Build better systems instead of relying on inefficient manual processes



The Ideal Candidate



You will be a strong fit if you:



* Have hands-on Australian bookkeeping experience

* Have strong experience using Xero

* Understand Australian GST and BAS processes

* Have experience with Australian suppliers and businesses

* Have experience with payroll and superannuation

* Are extremely detail-oriented

* Naturally question discrepancies

* Are proactive and take ownership of your work

* Have a positive and professional attitude

* Are reliable and committed to your work

* Can work independently without constant supervision

* Learn new systems quickly

* Are comfortable using technology and AI

* Can create SOPs and improve processes

* Can work in a fast-paced environment

* Think commercially, not just administratively



We Are NOT Looking For Someone Who:



* Only wants to process transactions without understanding them

* Needs to be told what to check

* Ignores discrepancies

* Is uncomfortable with technology

* Refuses to adapt to new systems

* Prefers manual processes simply because “that’s how it has always been done”

* Requires constant supervision

* Has a negative or difficult attitude toward feedback and process changes



AI & Technology



We are particularly interested in someone who is comfortable with AI and automation.



You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you should understand how tools such as ChatGPT and other technology can be used practically to:



* Reduce repetitive work

* Improve accuracy

* Create and maintain SOPs

* Analyse financial information

* Automate workflows

* Improve reporting

* Save time



How to Apply



If you are interested in this position, please send your application to:



📧

2. A brief summary of your Xero/bookkeeping experience

title: Recruiter
description:
Position Summary

The Recruitment Coordinator calls every applicant YESA receives online, qualifies them on the phone, and books the ones who pass into a recruiter's calendar. The measure of the role is booked interviews that show up — not dials logged.

This is a high-volume phone role. Applicant flow for door-to-door field sales is heavy and low-intent: most people who apply will not answer, and most who answer will not qualify. The Coordinator works that volume fast and without losing tone on the fortieth call of the day, so that recruiters spend their time interviewing qualified people instead of chasing unqualified ones.

Speed is the job's main lever. An applicant contacted within five minutes converts several times better than one contacted the next day, and YESA competes for the same candidates as every other field sales employer in the market. The Coordinator owns that response window.



This is a fully remote role, hired internationally, working North American business hours for the assigned market. The Coordinator reports to the Recruiter or Recruitment Manager for that market, and is the first human contact a candidate has with YESA — how that call sounds is how the company is judged.



What Success Looks Like

By 30 days — Trained on the YESA screen criteria, ATS and calendar process. Working the inbound queue independently. Hitting call volume, booking at roughly 70% of target.

By 60 days — Full booking target met weekly. Show rate above 60%. Working aged applicants and re-engagement lists, not just today's inbound.

By 90 days — Program complete, rate steps up. Consistently at target on booked-and-showed. Booked candidates converting to starts at a rate recruiters trust.

Key Performance Indicators

The Coordinator is measured on booked interviews that show, not on activity. Dial and contact volume are inputs the manager watches for coaching; they are not the target.

• Dials — 120–150 per day, 600–750 per week. Outbound call attempts to applicants.

• Live connects — 25–35 per day, 125–175 per week. Applicant answered and held a conversation.

• Qualified — 15–20 per day, 75–100 per week. Passed the screen criteria on the phone.

• Interviews booked — 12–15 per day, 60–75 per week. Confirmed slot in a recruiter's calendar.

• Booked and showed — 8–10 per day, 40–50 per week. Candidate attended. This is the primary target.

• Show rate — 65% or higher. Showed divided by booked.

• Speed to lead — 15 minutes or less, median, from application to first dial.

—

Weekly targets are set to feed one recruiter running at full capacity: 40–50 completed interviews per week is the recruiter's own target, and it only holds if the Coordinator is booking 60–75 to get there.

Two quality checks sit behind the volume. Downstream start rate — what share of showed candidates the recruiter takes to a signed offer — catches a Coordinator who is booking anyone to hit a number. Qualification accuracy — candidates who reach interview and fail on travel or direct sales experience, both of which should have been caught on the phone — is reviewed weekly with the recruiter and should sit under 10%.



Core Responsibilities

Applicant response

• Work the inbound applicant queue continuously through the day; call every new applicant within 15 minutes during business hours

• Run a persistent contact sequence — multiple call attempts across different times of day, plus text and
 — before marking an applicant unreachable

• Work aged and previously unreachable applicants on a set cadence; a candidate who did not answer in March may answer in May

Phone qualification

• Run the YESA phone screen on every live connect: right to work, travel and schedule availability, transportation, compensation expectations, and genuine interest in field sales

• Give an honest description of the work — doors, weather, rejection, commission — before booking. A candidate who books without understanding the job becomes a no-show or a week-three quit

• Disqualify clearly and respectfully when someone does not fit, and record why

Booking and show rate

• Book qualified candidates directly into the assigned recruiter's calendar, matching market and interview type

• Confirm every booking the same day and again the day before, by the channel the candidate actually responds on

• Rebook no-shows once; track no-show reasons and feed the patterns back to the recruiter

Pipeline and handoff

• Keep the ATS current in real time — dispositions, notes, and screen answers recorded during the call, not at the end of the day

• Write a short handoff note for every booked candidate so the recruiter opens the interview already knowing the basics

• Flag standout candidates immediately rather than letting them sit in a queue

Support

• Support hiring events and job fairs with pre-event confirmation calling and post-event follow-up

• Post and refresh job ads across boards as directed



Requirements

Must have

• Phone-based sales, appointment setting, or high-volume outbound experience. They have carried a daily call and booking target and can say what their numbers were. Recruitment experience is not required; phone stamina is

• Clear, easily understood spoken English. A North American applicant should be able to follow the call without effort. This is the single most common reason offshore coordinators fail in this role

• Experience calling into North American markets, or clear evidence they can handle the pace and idiom of those conversations

• Comfort making 120+ dials a day, indefinitely, with the same energy on the last call as the first

• Ability to hold a structured conversation and disqualify without being rude — warm on the phone, firm on the criteria

• Organized in a system: manages a live queue, records accurately as they go, does not lose people

• Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet dedicated workspace, a working headset, and a contingency for power or internet outages. Verified before hire, not assumed

• Available to work North American business hours for the assigned market, including some evenings and occasional Saturdays — that is when field sales applicants answer

• Able to be engaged as an independent contractor in their country of residence

Strongly preferred

• Experience calling into a cold or low-intent applicant or lead list, rather than warm inbound only

• Background in door-to-door, telecom, solar, alarm, or another commission-only field sales environment — they can describe the job credibly because they have lived it

• ATS or CRM fluency and comfort managing 200+ active records

• Bilingual English/French for Quebec markets

• Experience in a role where pay was tied to booked-and-showed, not dials



Screen-outs

Confirmed before the candidate reaches a live interview. Cannot sustain the call volume, or wants a role where calling is a portion of the day rather than the whole of it — decline. Cannot describe the field sales job honestly without apologizing for it — decline; the same squeamishness will cost YESA shows and starts.



Compensation

USD $9.00/hour, rising to USD $10.00/hour on completion of the 90-day program. Engaged as an independent contractor, responsible for their own taxes and statutory obligations in their country of residence.

title: META ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATOR/EDITOR
description:
META ADS | AI VIDEO GENERATOR/EDITOR

We're looking for an AI video generator/editor who understands one thing clearly:



A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for someone who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels.



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:



AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.



You should know how to make videos that:



Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds

Make the problem feel real and urgent

Show the product clearly and persuasively

Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase

You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes… then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.



THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:



Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them

Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

Can create multiple ad variations quickly

Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good

We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:



HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use

You also have experience with:



Meta/Facebook ad creatives

Short-form paid social videos

Long-form VSLs or sales videos

Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools

Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY

Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

Competitive compensation based on experience

Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives

The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

Clear creative direction and fast feedback

Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time

We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.



If you're an AI video generator/editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Outbound Call Center Agent
description:
About Us

We are one of the largest Hand & Stone Massage and Facial Spa franchise groups in the United States — 16+ spa locations across the country, and still opening more. Hand & Stone is one of America’s leading spa brands, helping hundreds of thousands of clients every year feel better through professional massage, facial, and wellness services.

Behind those spas is a remote outbound team that keeps our appointment books full — and we treat that team like true employees, not freelancers. Many of our agents have been with us for years. We invest in training, celebrate wins loudly, run contests constantly, and promote from within as we grow. When you join us, you’re joining a stable, growing American company that considers you part of the family.

Why You’ll Love This Job

• Guaranteed monthly salary — 42,000–55,000/month depending on experience, paid reliably, on time, every time. No waiting on clients or chasing invoices.

• Uncapped commissions — you earn on every appointment you book. Our top performers take home 85,000–115,000+ per month all-in.

• Warm leads only — every person you call has already asked about our services. No cold calling, no hostile hang-ups — just friendly conversations with people who want to book.

• Permanent work from home — a long-term, full-time career, not a short gig. Skip the commute and build your future from home.

• Contests, bonuses & recognition — regular contests and incentives that keep the work fun and put extra money in your pocket.

• Real career growth — we promote from within. Agents grow into team lead, training, and operations roles as we open new locations.

• Paid training & real support — proven scripts, ongoing coaching, and leadership that wants you to win.

What You’ll Do

• Call and text warm leads who requested information about massages, facials, and spa services — and book them into appointments at our spas

• Follow up with interested prospects until they book, with professionalism, confidence, and empathy

• Educate clients on our services, memberships, and current promotions to build excitement

• Hit daily and weekly booking goals with full support and coaching from leadership

• Log every call outcome accurately in our booking system

What We’re Looking For

• Excellent spoken and written English with a clear, friendly phone voice

• A confident, positive, coachable personality and the drive to meet goals

• Availability to work 40 hours/week during US business hours (night shift, Philippine time)

• Reliable high-speed internet, a quality headset, and a quiet workspace

• Sales, appointment setting, or call center experience is a plus — but attitude matters more



How to Apply

Start your application with the word SERENITY so we know you read this far. Then send us:

• Your resume

• A short note on why you’re a great fit

• A 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself (a link is fine — Vocaroo works great)

• A screenshot of your internet speed test from Speedtest.net

We review every complete application and respond quickly. We can’t wait to meet you!
